jobs.title: Territory Manager, Construction Services Business Development - Commercial Lines
jobs.excerpt: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you!
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a remote/work-from-home (WFH) production underwriting role that includes travel to key agency relationships within the assigned territory.

Territory: TBD but likely a combination of states in the overall Northeast.

Preferably, this individual will be based in or close to their respective territory.

Qualified candidates must have Commercial insurance underwriting experience (with authority) and a profitability & production orientated lens along with agency management.

Additionally:

  • Strong preference for commercial middle market expertise

  • Construction-specific insurance industry experience is ideal

  • Existing relationships with agency partner firms is highly desirable

The internal title for this role is Territory Manager, Construction Services Business Development - Commercial Lines.

This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.

Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Construction Services Territory Manager, you'll market, manage and underwrite commercial line business through direct contact with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through developing, negotiating and executing business plans. Collaboration with all internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence will be key to success.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and other factors necessary to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes plans to resolve those situations.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Reviews for acceptability and handles those within authority, aligned with underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work using company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with others to meet service level agreements.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, accountabilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the team on new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all products that may improve offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer and business development in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win business.

  • Consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique business. Provides industry trend observations to leadership. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability.

  • Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates and collaborates actively with team and leaders to share market intelligence, industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, and improve agency relationship. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority.

  • Proven ability to manage a significant workload effectively and back up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Manager or Director.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial line business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.


For NY residents please review the following state law information: Notice of Employee Rights, Protections, and Obligations LS740 (ny.gov)

NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:

We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

Job Description

The Workday Systems Analyst, HR International French) role will focus on Workday HR Administration, configuration, and support across the HCM workstreams for our international locations, including Canada (with emphasis on Quebec) and Mexico. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting complex, bilingual (English/French) HR environments and navigating regional compliance, tax, and benefits requirements—Quebec healthcare experience strongly preferred. This position ensures data integrity, optimizes HR processes, and provides responsive support to local HR teams to enable smooth day-to-day operations within Workday.

  • Administering configuration and maintenance of Workday Core HCM, Benefits, and Compensation modules for international entities, ensuring compliance with Canadian (including Quebec) and Mexican regulations.

  • Managing business processes, eligibility rules, validations, and reporting structures tailored to regional HR practices and labor standards.

  • Supporting local HR users with troubleshooting, data corrections, and guidance across HCM, ensuring adherence to bilingual documentation and audit requirements.

  • Coordinating testing and implementation of Workday releases and enhancements that impact international HR functionality and country-specific processes.

  • Partnering with HR leadership, HR Operations, and local HR teams in Canada and Mexico to align system design with local legislation, healthcare requirements, and internal governance policies.

Required Qualifications:

  • Fluency in French (written and spoken) as well as English

  • Strong knowledge of at least two of the following Workday modules: Core, HCM, Benefits or Compensation

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

  • Bachelor's Degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field

  • Workday Pro Certified in HCM Module

  • 2+ years of experience with Workday configuring and supporting at least two modules.

  • Proficiency in Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, and integration frameworks.

jobs.excerpt: This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job.
jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

About the Role

Donegal Insurance Group has an opening for a Business Relationship Manager for the state of Tennessee. As a member of our Marketing team, this position works to increase quote activity, written premium and improve retention while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction and profitability through the independent agency system.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Responsible for prospecting and appointment of agents in order to build a strong distribution channel.
  • Provide training to agencies on new programs and services in order to assist the agent in achieving their established goals and objectives with the company.
  • Effectively communicate Donegal Companies’ corporate goals, products, rules, rates, and incentives to agents to achieve a profitable book of business and build a strong business relationship.
  • Provide personalized attention on sales calls to ensure optimum position within the Agency.
  • Effectively communicate with each agency on the types of commercial lines business we are interested in quoting.
  • Responsible for directing agents to utilize Donegal’s WritePro and WriteBiz systems, and generating personal lines quote activity.
  • Will provide Commercial quotes to assist agents
  • Work closely with individual agents in order to generate new commercial lines business opportunities.
  • Develop individual Agency Plans, which include the financial objectives for the specific agent to include premium, loss ratio, new and renewal policy count goals. Discussions held frequently with Agents to review their progress versus plan toward their goals.
  • Analyze agency profitability for each agent within their assigned territory. Develops and implements agency action plans to meet financial and strategic goals and any corrective actions as needed. May include training, re-underwriting, rehabilitation programs, mergers or agency termination. Works closely with underwriting to implement corrective actions with agents as needed.
  • Facilitate at least two agency reviews each year with underwriting to review the agent’s performance as compared to the established goals and implements correctives measures as needed.
  • Responsible for marketing company products and services. This includes a working knowledge of the interface capabilities of our company, monitoring of agency activity and arranging training of new products and services.
  • Routinely visit agents in assigned territory and prospect for quality agency appointments.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in marketing, business administration or related field
  • 5+ years of property and casualty insurance experience
  • Knowledge of the independent agency system, Commercial, & Personal lines of insurance.
  • Comfortable working with larger commercial agencies, and familiar with agents within the territory
  • Strong commercial lines insurance experience and knowledge preferred
  • Ability to work independently and highly motivated
  • Continuing education and insurance designations highly preferred
Starting Pay: The pay range for this position is $90,000 to $120,000 annually. The specific offer will vary based on an applicant's education, qualifications, professional experience, skills, abilities, and any applicable designations/certifications. The posted pay range reflects our ability to hire at different position titles and levels depending on background and experience. The pay range may also be adjusted based on an applicant's geographic location.

The base pay is just one component of Donegal's total compensation package for employees. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

Ongoing applications are being accepted.

To apply, please submit your resume and online application

Competitive Benefits Package

Donegal Insurance Group offers a comprehensive benefits package for all full-time, permanent positions including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Available to you and your dependents. Coverage begins the first of the month after start date.
  • 401(k) with the first 3% matched at 100%: the next 6% is matched at 50%
  • Paid Time Off: Paid vacation, sick days, paid holidays, & bereavement days
  • Career Development: Including college partnership discounts and industry designation(s) reimbursements

Additional benefits include company-paid basic life insurance; short & long-term disability insurance; employee stock purchase plan; and employee assistance program (EAP). Learn more about our full benefit offerings by visiting our Benefits page.

Who We Are

Donegal Insurance Group provides commercial and personal insurance products through a network of independent agents in 21 states and across several regions of the U.S. In Texas, Colorado, Utah, New Mexico and Arizona, business is conducted under the Mountain States Insurance Group name; and in Michigan, business is conducted under the Michigan Insurance name.

Headquartered in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, along with four (4) regional offices located in: Athens, GA, Grand Rapids, MI, Albuquerque, NM, and Glen Allen, VA, our steady growth and successes have allowed us to establish a culture of which we're proud. Check out our Glassdoor profile where our rating speaks for itself:

By joining Donegal, you would be joining a team of dedicated, hard-working employees, all with a common goal of providing peace of mind to our policyholders and being There when it matters most.™.

With each department and position being different, the work arrangement for a specific position will be reviewed with candidates during a initial phone screening. The Rare Cardiology Field Medical, Team Leader possesses deep Therapeutic Area knowledge and is responsible for managing and developing a team of Rare Cardiology Field Medical colleagues.

Rare Cardiology Field Medical, Team Leader Role Responsibilities

  • Perform all Rare Cardiology Field Medical responsibilities in order to lead, manage, develop, and coach a team of Rare Cardiology Field Medical colleagues with Rare Cardiology and Pfizer medicine expertise

  • Guide work prioritization and resource allocation within team, and authorize expenditures for team related to travel, training, supplies, and other miscellaneous expenses

  • Conduct HR-related issues for assigned team (such as performance appraisals, salary planning, new colleague selection, colleague development plans, colleague retention, team culture, and conflict resolution) and manage concerns in a timely and compliant manner

  • Ensure team activities are conducted in compliance with all policies, guidelines, and regulations, and that team members complete all assigned trainings within the specified timeframe

  • Collaborate and partner effectively with Medical Governance team as appropriate

  • Partner with administrative professional staff to ensure effective support is provided to the Rare Cardiology Field Medical team

  • Assist the Rare Cardiology HQ Medical Affairs team with the strategic planning, development, inclusion of Field Medical insights, and execution of team Medical plan for Rare Cardiology, including budget planning

  • Support the Rare Cardiology HQ Medical Affairs team in the assessment and roll-out of major above-brand strategic initiatives

  • Ensure that communication and collaboration between HQ Medical Affairs and Rare Cardiology Field Medical and commercial functions are effective, appropriate, and compliant

  • Take accountability for the Medical Review Committee approval process within Rare Cardiology, ensuring appropriate approval of Medical content for Rare Cardiology Field Medical use in accordance with Pfizer Medical policies and SOPs

  • Serve on Rare Cardiology Field Medical and/or cross-functional committees and teams as requested by Medical Affairs leadership

  • Interact with investigators and other HCPs as appropriate in clinical and research activities

  • Understand, communicate, and adhere to current FDA and other US regulations and guidance that impact interactions with and delivery of medical information to external HCPs

  • Anticipate and lead team to effectively adopt new digital technology, on-demand, and other related offerings that improve the efficiency of Rare Cardiology Field Medical communications and activities and that enhance the overall Medical customer experience

  • Remain up to date on scientific and medical literature and developments within Rare Cardiology

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a health science required

  • PharmD, PhD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree (e.g., Doctor of Nursing Practice, Doctor of Physical Therapy) highly preferred

  • Relevant experience required: 12 years with bachelor’s degree; 10 with MBA/MS and 7 with PharmD, PhD

  • Demonstrate a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes, and create business impact

  • Demonstrate leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, develop, and lead a team in a complex, changing environment that is focused on generating a positive Medical customer experience while embodying the Pfizer Core Values

  • Possess strong strategic, analytical, self-awareness, and interpersonal skills

  • Able to work independently while demonstrating flexibility and organizational awareness, adapting to changes within short timeframes

Demonstrate ability to:

  • Manage a diverse team of geographically dispersed professionals

  • Manage a significant volume of projects developed in a remote environment, while exhibiting the ability to prioritize, successfully implement, and demonstrate excellent judgment skills and work in a continuous improvement environment

  • Work within a matrixed, multi-disciplinary team to foster strong Pfizer/customer professional relationships which are aligned with Pfizer Medical objectives

  • Effectively manage through and lead change in an ever-changing and evolving external health care environment

  • Demonstrate change agility; be flexible to new opportunities (e.g. new therapeutic areas) and adaptable to organizational change

  • Problem-solve and network enterprise wide as appropriate to identify solutions

  • Collaborate effectively and demonstrate leadership and teamwork with peers, internal stakeholders and external customers that inspires alignment and partnership on a shared vision or strategy

  • Be a self-starter, be accountable, and have a sense of urgency in delivering results that have medical impact and yield a positive customer experience

  • Be decisive but exercise good judgement in decisions

  • Maintain self-awareness and continually choose behaviors and responses based on how it impacts one’s own and others’ performance and engagement

  • Demonstrate clinical and technical skills

  • Rapidly adopt and utilize new digital technology and other resources with medical customers and record medical interactions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with internal/external SOPs/Rules/Regulations regarding Pfizer/customer interactions and relationships, etc.

  • Previous Field Medical experience

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Operate a Pfizer company car and regularly fly on airplanes (i.e. attend HCP/customer meetings; attend NYHQ meetings, etc. required; proximity to airline ‘hub’ city); maintain flexibility to travel approximately 50% of time

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired

Other Job Details

  • Last Date to Apply for Job: September 18, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $230,900.00 to $384,800.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 25.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

The AVP, Senior Trustee Consultant will be an integral member of the Business Development team within LPL’s wholly owned subsidiary The Private Trust Company. Our innovative, entrepreneurial, high-performing team helps independent advisors and RIAs by providing trustee services to their clients. Through our delegated model The Private Trust Company enables LPL Advisors to maintain investment management and relationship management responsibilities.

We are looking for an experienced and engaging trust professional who is passionate about helping LPL Advisors provide trustee services to their clients, including High Net Worth and Ultra High Net Worth relationships. This role is responsible for delivering an exceptional experience while supporting LPL Advisor inquiries and advancing new trustee opportunities through our acceptance process and into onboarding. This role will be a key contributor to LPL advisor satisfaction and PTC's ability to generate repeat business.

Responsibilities:

  • Trustee Case Consultant: Serve as the lead consultant with LPL Advisors when they present new cases to PTC for trustee and/or settlement services. Exhibit thorough knowledge of both trust administration and settlement services. Analyze and interpret relevant legal documents and asset statements. Including wills, trusts, agreements, entity documents, investment statements, and special asset information in relation to the clients’ trust(s) and/or estate. Summarize and prepare new cases for legal and acceptance reviews. Including, mentoring and coaching trust specialists to assist you in preparing summaries, document management and communication with advisors, trustees, attorneys and beneficiaries.
  • Relationship Management and Client Service: Manage financial advisor and client experience while providing service and support for moderately complex to complex trustee cases. Identify client needs, address client concerns, resolve issues (with guidance from senior officers where appropriate) and respond to client inquiries while keeping relevant parties involved. Effectively communicate with financial advisors, external partners and colleagues throughout all steps of PTC’s trustee acceptance process.
  • Project Management: Superior organizational and follow up skills to ensure the new business opportunity pipeline is managed both efficiently and diligently. Participate in special projects and initiatives, create effective working relationships with colleagues and peers within PTC and across LPL. Collaborate with colleagues and associates to enhance best practices, engage appropriate resources and foster strong team dynamics.
  • PTC Brand Ambassador: Represent PTC in business development efforts with internal partners at LPL and with LPL Advisors.

Other Duties:

  • Participating in LPL advisor and client meetings as needed
  • Preparation of special reports, spreadsheets and correspondence, as needed

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Five years’ experience in trustee services, preferably with a broker-dealer or in a traditional bank/trust company. Knowledge of financial planning, philanthropic planning and fiduciary law.
  • Experience working with high net worth (HNW) clients
  • Will have a proven ability to successfully handle multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines in a quality-first, team-oriented environment
  • Strong use of Microsoft Office

Core Competencies:

  • Verbal and written communication skills for effective interactions with clients, financial advisors, and other professionals

Preferences:

  • CTFA, CFP or ChFC

Pay Range:

$88,580.00 - $147,599.00Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.


At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.


For further information about LPL, please visit .

LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an @lplfinancial.com email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. jobs.title: Senior Tax Associate
jobs.excerpt: Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well.
jobs.description:
Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

About The Role

Facet is seeking an experienced Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to step into a high-touch, member-facing role as a Senior Tax Associate. If you love the strategic advisory side of public accounting or private wealth management—but dread tax season, compliance filings, and timesheets—this is the ideal next step in your career.

In this consultative position, you will be on the frontline, leading weekly virtual tax strategy sessions directly with Facet members. You will translate complex tax laws into actionable, high-impact strategies without ever filing a tax return. Partnering closely with our CFP® Lead Planners, you will apply Facet’s modern tax planning framework to empower members to make confident, tax-optimized life decisions.

Key Highlights:

  • No Tax Return Preparation or Compliance: 100% focused on forward-looking planning, education, and member advisory.
  • Direct Member Impact: High-cadence consultation environment leading 10–15 video strategy sessions per week.
  • Modern Wealth Management: Operate as the subject matter expert within a modern, tech-enabled RIA structure.
  • Balanced Work Load: NO BUSY SEASON!

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Direct Member Consultations: Lead 10–15 virtual strategy sessions per week, delivering tailored tax advice, answering complex real-time questions, and guiding members through high-stakes financial decisions.
  • Continuous Member Engagement: Serve as the primary tax sounding board for members by delivering clear, plain-English answers to day-to-day inbound questions via our secure messaging platform (covering withholdings, life events, IRS notices, and tax projections).
  • Proactive Tax Plan Diagnostic: Review member tax returns (Form 1040s and schedules) to diagnose multi-year optimization opportunities, including Roth conversions, equity vesting events, real estate transactions, and executive compensation.
  • Custom Modeling & Scenario Analysis: Build, model, and present customized tax strategies using modern planning tools—focusing on bracket management, withholding adjustments, and estimated tax schedules.
  • Technical Research & Analysis: Perform deep-dive research into complex federal and multi-state tax scenarios to architect compliant, creative strategies across diverse household profiles.
  • Planner Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our Lead Planners and Director of Specialized Advice to integrate tax optimization seamlessly into overall holistic financial plans.

Commonly Advised Strategies & Domains

  • Roth Conversion & Income Optimization: Evaluating income streams for multi-year Roth conversion strategies while managing downstream impacts on IRMAA brackets, ACA subsidies, and Social Security taxation.
  • Real Estate & Rental Assets: Advising on cost recovery, depreciation, Passive Activity Loss (PAL) rules, short-term rental strategies, and Section 1031 exchanges.
  • Charitable Giving Strategies: Structuring high-impact options, including Donor-Advised Funds (DAFs), Qualified Charitable Distributions (QCDs), and appreciated stock gifting.
  • Small Business & Entity Structuring: Advising business owners on entity selection (Sole Prop, S-Corp, LLC), Section 199A QBI optimization, pass-through taxation, and exit planning.
  • Equity Compensation: Navigating tax impacts of ISOs, NSOs, RSUs, and ESPPs, including Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) strategies and liquidity event planning.

Requirements

  • Active Credential:Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license required.
  • Relevant Experience: 5–7+ years of professional experience specializing in personal tax planning, private client tax advisory, high-net-worth tax consulting, or wealth management.
  • Member-Facing Excellence: Demonstrated history of managing a regular client meeting cadence (e.g., 10–15 client consultations weekly) with exceptional empathy, active listening, and strong presentation skills over video.
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Expert ability to analyze Form 1040s and supporting schedules rapidly to spot tax inefficiencies, missed opportunities, and exposure risks.
  • Deep Technical Knowledge: Strong expertise in individual federal and state tax codes, pass-through entities, retirement distribution strategies, and executive compensation planning.
  • Fiduciary Ethos: Uncompromising integrity and a dedication to delivering objective, member-first advice.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation or active pursuit of the credential.
    • Prior experience delivering advisory services within a fee-only RIA, multi-family office, or wealth management firm alongside CFP® professionals.
    • High proficiency with modern tax modeling tools (Holistiplan, BNA, Corvee) and CRM/digital workflow tools.

Benefits

  • $110,000 – $150,000 base salary: Determined by experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Equity (ISO): It is important to us that all employees are shareholders in our mission.
  • Flexible PTO
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, short/long-term disability (paid by Facet), life insurance, and paid parental leave.
  • Certification and wellness reimbursement programs
  • Work from anywhere in the US

*Facet was ranked #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY in April 2025 who partnered with Statista to rank the top 500 RIAs. Recommendations were collected via an independent survey among over 30,000 individuals. Self-recommendations were prohibited, and no compensation was provided for the ranking. Facet has been Accredited with the Better Business Bureau® since June 2025, and as of February 2026 holds an A+ BBB Rating. This Accreditation does not imply BBB approval or endorsement. Plant-A Insights Group and Newsweek partnered to identify America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. This analysis was performed with data as of September 2024 and reviewed over 15,000 financial advisories registered with the SEC. These rankings prepared by Plant-A reflect editorial content and no compensation was provided by Facet in connection with America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. As of February 25, 2026; Facet has a 4.8 star rating with TrustPilot.com. TrustPilot uses a formula for calculation that considers three factors: time span, frequency, and Bayesian average. After the calculation, a TrustScore is then visualized into a star rating from 1 to 5 stars, including half stars. Facet’s star rating is calculated from reviews from January of 2022 to present day. Daily star rating may fluctuate. Companies on Trustpilot aren't allowed to offer incentives or pay to hide reviews and Facet has not made any payments in offer or receipt of any reviews.

jobs.title: Mobile Application Business Analyst (Employed or freelance)
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésVous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux. Dans le cadre de la refonte complète d’une application mobile, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins métier en éléments fonctionnels clairs, cohérents et exploitables par les équipes UX/UI et de développement.

Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de définition fonctionnelle jusqu’à la préparation du développement, avec une attention particulière portée à la cohérence entre parcours utilisateurs, écrans, backlog et critères d’acceptation.

Description de mission

Le rôle consiste à faire le lien entre :

  • les besoins métier,
  • l’expérience utilisateur (UX),
  • les équipes design,
  • les équipes de développement,
  • l’architecture,
  • la QA et la gestion de projet.

Vous êtes garant de la structuration des parcours utilisateurs, de la transformation des besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et de la traçabilité entre les différentes étapes de conception et de delivery.

Responsabilités principales

1. Analyse métier et cadrage fonctionnel

  • Recueillir les besoins métier et utilisateurs.
  • Challenge les demandes afin d’en clarifier les objectifs réels.
  • Structurer les User Journeys et formaliser les parcours détaillés.
  • Identifier les pain points, les cas complexes et les dépendances.
  • Prioriser les besoins avec les parties prenantes du projet.

2. Structuration des parcours utilisateurs

  • Définir les parcours de bout en bout.
  • Décomposer chaque parcours en étapes détaillées.
  • Prendre en compte les variantes, exceptions, cas d’erreur, scénarios offline, dépendances temps réel et besoins d’accessibilité (PMR).
  • Garantir une couverture complète des scénarios critiques et des edge cases.

3. Transformation des besoins en éléments exploitables

Vous structurez et maintenez la traçabilité complète entre :

User Journey → Features → Screens → User Stories → Acceptance Criteria

  • Transformer les besoins métier en fonctionnalités détaillées.
  • Réaliser le screen mapping et contribuer au screen inventory.
  • Formaliser des wireflows fonctionnels clairs.
  • Veiller à l’exhaustivité des écrans et à la cohérence des comportements attendus.

4. Préparation du travail UX/UI

  • Préparer les éléments nécessaires au travail des designers.
  • Définir le maillage des écrans et les comportements fonctionnels.
  • Documenter les différents états : loading, error, empty, offline et edge cases.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les UX/UI Designers pour assurer la cohérence des parcours.

5. Gestion et structuration du backlog

  • Rédiger les Epics et les User Stories.
  • Définir des Acceptance Criteria précis et exploitables.
  • Structurer les dépendances et préparer les refinements.
  • Maintenir un backlog complexe clair, priorisé et actionnable dans un cadre Agile / Scrum.

6. Coordination avec les équipes de delivery

  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques afin de clarifier les comportements attendus.
  • Participer aux ateliers UX/UI et aux refinements Agile.
  • Apporter un support aux équipes QA/UAT.
  • Faciliter l’alignement entre les besoins métier, la conception et l’implémentation.

7. Documentation et gouvernance fonctionnelle

  • Maintenir la documentation fonctionnelle dans Confluence.
  • Utiliser des outils de modélisation tels que Draw.io lorsque pertinent.
  • Structurer les référentiels fonctionnels avec rigueur.
  • Garantir la cohérence documentaire et la traçabilité entre besoins, parcours, écrans, stories et tests.
  • Assurer une rédaction fonctionnelle de haut niveau, adaptée à des projets mobiles complexes.

Livrables attendus

  • User Journeys détaillés
  • Mapping fonctionnel
  • Screen Inventory
  • Wireflows fonctionnels
  • Epics
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Documentation Confluence
  • Support aux scénarios UAT
  • Matrices de traçabilité

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Senior Business Analyst, idéalement dans des environnements digitaux et sur des projets mobiles complexes.

Compétences essentielles :

  • Business Analysis digitale
  • Structuration de backlogs complexes
  • Rédaction fonctionnelle
  • User Journeys
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Screen Mapping
  • Wireflows
  • Gestion des edge cases et des scénarios critiques
  • Méthodologies Agile / Scrum
  • Confluence
  • Draw.io

Soft skills recherchés :

  • Excellente capacité de structuration et grande rigueur documentaire
  • Très bonne communication avec des interlocuteurs variés
  • Esprit analytique et vision systémique
  • Capacité à travailler dans des environnements transverses et à faciliter des ateliers
  • Approche pragmatique, orientée solution, utilisateur et delivery

Langues :

  • Néerlandais ou français
  • Anglais

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

jobs.excerpt: About AppFollowAppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers.
jobs.description:
About AppFollow

    AppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers. Support teams use it to handle reviews at scale, product teams turn user feedback into insights, and marketing and ASO teams grow app store visibility. We're a B2B SaaS company serving SMB, mid-market and enterprise clients, with a remote team based mostly in Europe.

Role overview

    We're hiring our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager. You'll own how AppFollow's products are positioned, launched and explained, both to the market and inside the company.

    You report to the CEO and work with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success teams, each needing something different from you. Product needs you to understand new features early, turn them into a clear market story and bring back what customers say about them. Marketing needs one person who knows the product inside out and produces the source of truth for campaigns, webinars and landing pages. Sales and Customer Success need positioning against competitors, a current deck and proof they can use in a demo.

    This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. There's nobody to delegate to, and most of the workflows described below don't exist yet. You'll build them.

Key responsibilities

    Positioning and messaging. Own who we're for, what we do better than competitors, and how that shows up in our messaging. You run this work with the leadership team and carry the result onto the website's product pages and everywhere else the product is described.

    Product launches. Lead every feature launch from the marketing side, from the start of development rather than the week before release. Understand the use cases with the product manager, define the message, build the launch plan and run the campaign to prospects and existing accounts together with Sales. Then measure it: opportunities created, accounts activated.

    Product feedback loop. Join sales and CS calls during betas and launches. Aggregate what prospects and customers say about a new feature (Fathom, AI tooling, your own system), define the questions the sales team should be asking, and feed the findings back to Product and Marketing: what's not landing, what needs to change in messaging or on landing pages, which use cases we're missing.

    Case studies and proof. Own the customer story pipeline: first use cases after each launch, case studies, testimonials. If a key use case has no proof yet, go get it.

    Internal source of truth. For every product and feature, keep a current, plain-language description of what it does, who it's for, why it beats the alternatives, proof points and customer quotes (we use Guru). Marketing, Sales, CS and Growth all work from it. This is not technical documentation.

    Sales and CS materials. Own the master sales deck as a modular set of approved slides and review it with the Head of Sales roughly every quarter. Help Sales find the "wow moment" for demos of new features. Translate features into business outcomes. Sales training and one-off pitch preparation stay with the Head of Sales.

    Cross-sell and upsell. Run announcement campaigns to existing and free accounts around new features and products, and coordinate with Growth on in-product channels.

How we measure success

  • Feature adoption after launch (accounts using a new feature or add-on)

  • Case studies published and launch materials ready on launch day (source of truth, deck, landing page copy)

  • Qualified pipeline (MQLs/SQLs) from product launches and launch campaigns

  • Cross-sell and upsell opportunities from campaigns to the existing base

Who we're looking for

    Experience. 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, most of it in startups where you did the work yourself. You've launched products, owned positioning and worked side by side with sales. Experience in mobile apps, ASO or gaming is a strong plus, as is knowing how both product-led and sales-led motions work.

    Way of working. Proactive. You pick up what's broken without waiting for a launch date or a request from Sales, and you're comfortable saying "this is what we're not doing."

    AI-native. You use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools daily and build your own workflows on top of them: aggregating call feedback, maintaining product knowledge, drafting content. We expect you to plug into our internal integrations (Fathom, HubSpot, Guru, Salesforce, Amplitude, Canny) and keep the product knowledge base the most current thing in the company.

    Data. Comfortable reading funnel and campaign data, building a spreadsheet and defending a conclusion.

    Communication. Fluent English, strong writing. Another language (Spanish, Portuguese, Russian) is a plus. Comfortable presenting at webinars and events as a public face for the product.

    Video production skills (Screen Studio, CapCut) are a plus, not a requirement.

What we offer

  • Remote role anywhere in Europe; hubs in Spain, Portugal, Serbia and Finland

  • Colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil

  • Conference participation in app, gaming and product marketing events

  • Equity options after probation, quarterly performance bonuses

  • Annual offline team meetup and company all-hands

  • Monthly coworking budget, laptop and home office equipment

  • Internal hackathons 2–3 times a year

  • Direct work with the CEO and leadership team; you build a function from zero

Hiring process

  • Applications open: mid-Sept

  • Screening call (30 min): second half of Sept

  • Take-home assignment and panel interview with Sales, Marketing and Product (60 min): early Oct

  • Offer: by 15 Oct

    • Dates are our target and may shift. We move fast and interview as applications come in, so early applicants hear back sooner.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Sr. Actuarial Consultant – Life Insurance Valuation REMOTE

Build your expertise in life insurance valuation

Join our Life Insurance Valuation team as a Sr. Actuarial Consultant and apply your actuarial knowledge to our life insurance products. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to accurate, efficient, and compliant valuation processes while developing expertise in evolving regulatory standards, actuarial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.

You’ll work with experienced actuaries and cross-functional partners in Tax, Controllership, Pricing, and other business areas. Your contributions will help support monthly and quarterly valuation activities, strengthen processes, and advance the team’s modernized analytical environment.

What you’ll do

  • Apply actuarial knowledge to life insurance valuation activities for life products.

  • Support the implementation and analysis of evolving standards, including Long-Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) and Principle-Based Reserving (PBR).

  • Prepare, analyze, and explain results for assigned monthly and quarterly valuation deliverables.

  • Develop and enhance tools used to validate and analyze valuation results.

  • Collaborate with Tax, Controllership, Pricing, and other stakeholders to support business objectives.

  • Assist with responses to auditor and regulator inquiries by providing accurate, well-supported analysis.

What you’ll bring

  • Knowledge of actuarial business functions and life insurance valuation principles.

jobs.description:
Job Family:

IT Project Management

Travel Required:

None

Clearance Required:

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

The Technical Project Manager will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technical initiatives supporting the GrantSolutions contract. Efforts may include application and platform modernization, system enhancements, new capabilities, integrations, cloud adoption, cybersecurity initiatives, and operational improvements. The role requires strong project leadership and sufficient familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications to engage technical teams, understand delivery dependencies and risks, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The Technical Project Manager will coordinate cross-functional and multi-vendor teams; manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and change; and partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, engineering and operations leads, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

What You Will Do:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of technical efforts, including modernization initiatives, system and application enhancements, new capability delivery, platform improvements, integrations, and technology upgrades. This role will manage delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, coordinating work across multiple workstreams, vendors, and agile teams while maintaining service continuity and alignment with business priorities.

The Technical Project Manager will establish delivery baselines and governance, manage requirements and change, track performance and financials, facilitate technical and business decisions, and coordinate quality, security, release, operational readiness, and stakeholder adoption. This individual will support initiatives involving cloud-hosted applications, integrations, shared services, data exchanges, infrastructure, and emerging capabilities. Success requires sound judgment, technical curiosity, concise executive communication, and the ability to create accountability without displacing the responsibilities of Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, or Technical Leads.

  • Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition to operations, and closeout, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

  • Define and maintain project charters, scope, objectives, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps, and governance cadence.

  • Manage day-to-day execution across multiple agile teams, technical workstreams, vendors, and shared services; clarify roles, commitments, interfaces, and decision rights.

  • Partner with Product Owners and technical leads to translate business and technical requirements into prioritized, achievable release plans while maintaining traceability from objectives through delivered capabilities.

  • Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, procurement and vendor commitments, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions using appropriate controls.

  • Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, and timely escalation of financial risks.

  • Establish and administer integrated change control, assessing proposed changes for business value and impacts to architecture, scope, cost, schedule, security, operations, and contractual commitments.

  • Coordinate architecture, application development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, data, testing, configuration management, and operations stakeholders to meet delivery and governance requirements.

  • Drive release and operational readiness, including environment and integration dependencies, test completion, defect disposition, data migration, deployment planning, rollback and contingency planning, training, communications, support readiness, and production handoff.

  • Track technical dependencies across applications, cloud services, APIs, data exchanges, security components, environments, and shared platform capabilities.

  • Coordinate delivery planning for AWS-hosted environments and Java-based applications, working with technical leads to understand architecture, security, integration, deployment, and operational considerations.

  • Proactively manage implementation and transition risks, including workflow continuity, system-of-record decisions, overlapping capabilities, data synchronization, technical debt, testing scope, deployment sequencing, and operational impacts.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics and key performance indicators, such as milestone performance, forecast accuracy, throughput, cycle time, quality trends, defect leakage, dependency aging, and risk exposure; use data to drive recovery plans and continuous improvement.

  • Prepare concise executive dashboards, weekly and monthly status reports, decision briefs, and forecasts that clearly communicate progress, financial status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

  • Facilitate planning sessions, technical reviews, risk reviews, stakeholder forums, retrospectives, and decision meetings; document actions, owners, due dates, and outcomes.

  • Manage vendor performance against plans, deliverables, service expectations, quality criteria, and contractual obligations, escalating gaps and coordinating remediation.

  • Maintain complete, audit-ready project records, including baselines, plans, RAID logs, decisions, approvals, change records, status reports, meeting outcomes, and lessons learned.

  • Build trusted relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, architects, delivery teams, and operations partners while promoting accountability, constructive conflict resolution, team empowerment, and a culture of continuous improvement.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD Public Trust; approved adjudication is required before onboarding. An active Public Trust or suitability determination is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, project management, or a related field.

  • Minimum of Twelve (12) years of prior relevant experience

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience managing complex software development, cloud, systems integration, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success managing end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholder groups, including projects in which legacy and modern platforms operate concurrently.

  • Strong command of project management disciplines, including scope, schedule, cost, resource, quality, procurement, risk, communications, stakeholder, and change management.

  • Experience using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid, and predictive delivery approaches, with the judgment to tailor practices to project risk, complexity, governance, and contractual needs.

  • Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and modern delivery practices, including cloud environments, application development, integrations, testing, release management, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and operational readiness.

  • Experience managing technical initiatives involving AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications, with the ability to understand dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and operational impacts at a project-management level.

  • Ability to understand architecture diagrams, interface dependencies, technical tradeoffs, nonfunctional requirements, and security or compliance constraints, and translate them into actionable plans without serving as the solution architect.

  • Experience establishing governance, baselines, stage gates, acceptance criteria, metrics, dashboards, and audit-ready project documentation.

  • Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, estimating, forecasting, variance analysis, EAC, ETC, and resource capacity planning.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • PMP certification; PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, ITIL, or comparable agile, service management, or scaled delivery certification.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, evaluate options, manage ambiguity, resolve conflict, negotiate commitments, and drive timely risk-based decisions.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, with a collaborative, accountable, customer-focused, and solution-oriented leadership style.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project or an equivalent scheduling tool and working proficiency with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and dashboard or reporting tools.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

  • Experience delivering federal or regulated technology programs aligned with government lifecycle, cybersecurity, accessibility, privacy, records management, and audit requirements.

  • Experience supporting delivery of AWS-hosted applications, Java-based systems, APIs, integrations, or DevSecOps-enabled initiatives.

  • AWS or related cloud certification and familiarity with enterprise Java application environments.

  • Experience managing API-enabled integration layers, data exchange patterns, canonical data models, identity and access integration, or interface-control processes.

  • Experience leading multi-vendor delivery within a shared enterprise architecture and managing contractual deliverables, service levels, subcontractor dependencies, and vendor remediation plans.

  • Experience with organizational change management, user-centered design, training, communications, adoption, and transition-to-operations activities.

  • Experience applying quantitative delivery metrics, earned value or comparable performance-management techniques, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned to improve predictability and outcomes.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

  • Collaborative leadership: Builds alignment around a shared vision, sets clear expectations, delegates effectively, and empowers teams to take ownership of outcomes.

  • Emotional intelligence: Demonstrates self-awareness, empathy, composure, and situational awareness when navigating high-pressure environments and diverse perspectives.

  • Communication and active listening: Communicates with clarity and transparency, tailors messages to the audience, asks thoughtful questions, and confirms shared understanding.

  • Influence and negotiation: Builds consensus and secures commitments across teams and stakeholders, including situations where direct authority is limited.

  • Conflict resolution: Addresses disagreement early, facilitates constructive dialogue, separates issues from individuals, and drives practical, equitable resolutions.

  • Adaptability and resilience: Remains calm and effective amid shifting priorities, incomplete information, technical complexity, and delivery pressure.

  • Decisiveness and accountability: Makes timely, evidence-based decisions, communicates tradeoffs, follows through on commitments, and holds self and others constructively accountable.

  • Integrity and trust: Models ethical behavior, discretion, reliability, transparency, and respect in interactions with clients, partners, and team members.

  • Coaching and team development: Provides actionable feedback, recognizes contributions, supports professional growth, and creates psychological safety for questions, learning, and responsible escalation.

  • Inclusive collaboration: Values varied expertise and perspectives, promotes respectful participation, and fosters productive partnerships across technical, business, vendor, and Federal teams.

  • Soft Skills and Leadership Qualities:

The Clinical Consultant provides clinical and application support for both customers and internal sales force related to the Baxter vital sign and cardiology product line delivered in a hospital or clinic setting. Home Base: This is a remote position with a preferred home base of Minnesota or Florida.
