jobs.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less.
jobs.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. As far as we know, we are the only true scaling research advisory firm in the world. Not “growth,” but scale.

We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue (With many of our clients between $100M and $1B+) who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales.

Our creative library includes multiple NYT best-selling books, large podcast appearances, keynotes, live events, client/member interviews, case studies, client/member training material, webinars, founder content, and hundreds of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of hooks each week. When the market tells us a hook is working, this role turns that signal into a larger family of direct-response video ads. We are looking for someone who has already written high-performing video creative and scripts at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will not begin with a blank page. You will receive a winning hook, a proven video ad, or a clear performance signal. Your job is to understand why it worked, find the strongest evidence and source material connected to it in our media library, develop the angle, write new versions, and hand the production team a clear creative direction that can become a finished ad.

This is primarily a video-ad strategy and scriptwriting role. It combines direct-response strategy, AI-assisted research, source mining, writing, creative iteration, and performance learning. You should also be capable of handling other direct-response copywriting needs when required, but video scripts are the center of the job.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

  • Receive winning hooks, proven video ads, winners and losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests from our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Diagnose why it worked: the audience, pain, belief, promise, proof, curiosity, identity, or objection it activated. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Use AI to search our content database for supporting material across testimonials, founder podcasts, books, posts, keynotes, trainings, member stories, and excerpts from our twice-yearly live events. Stay deeply current by regularly consuming our books, every founder podcast appearance and keynote, live-event content, trainings, and the weekly case-study podcast produced for our members.
  • Build an evidence bank around the angle. This may include dozens of testimonials, short proof points, founder clips, book lines, customer language, objections, and supporting stories.
  • Write three or four new hook options, develop the body, choose the proof sequence, and create a clear flow for the video ad.
  • Package the developed angle for a Creative Producer and Editor. Give them the message, key lines, source material, intended flow, and what the ad must accomplish without prescribing every visual decision.
  • Review the finished ad to protect the strategy and clarify anything that was lost in execution.
  • When an ad wins, create new variations by changing the hook, body, proof, order, framing, or CTA, and by recombining elements from multiple winners.
  • When the paid-media team flags a winning ad for refresh, identify what should be preserved and what should change so the next version can beat it.
  • Repeat the cycle quickly. Some ads may only perform for a few weeks because we intend to scale spend aggressively.

What You Own

  • Winning-hook expansion
  • Angle development
  • AI-assisted source research
  • Testimonial and proof mining
  • Video ad scripts and copy
  • Hook and body variations
  • Creative briefs and source packages
  • Winner iteration
  • Winner refreshes
  • Performance learning
  • Claim and source accuracy

What Success Looks Like

  • A dependable flow of strong, evidence-backed angles keeps the production team moving.
  • New video ads come from proven market signals without becoming minor copies of the original.
  • Winning video ads produce useful creative families as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Research is fast, deep, traceable, and materially improves the writing.
  • Editors and designers receive enough direction to protect the message while still owning the execution.
  • The work produces qualified demand, not merely clicks or internal enthusiasm.

What We Need to See

  • Direct-response video-ad work with clear personal ownership and measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, booked calls, conversion, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.
  • The ability to explain why a hook or ad worked and how you turned that learning into the next test.
  • Experience selling a complex, intangible, high-consideration offer. Expert-led, education, or information businesses are strongly preferred.
  • Strong research judgment across transcripts, testimonials, long-form content, books, customer language, and performance data.
  • A real AI-enabled research and writing workflow that increased speed or creative range without producing generic work.
  • Fast, decisive collaboration with producers, editors, and designers.
  • Excellent judgment around claims, testimonials, attribution, and source accuracy.

This Role Is Not

  • Brand copy without a measurable action
  • Generic content strategy
  • Starting every assignment from a blank page
  • Prompt output passed off as thinking
  • A writer who disappears after handoff
  • A project-management layer between strategy and production

How to Apply

Send one direct-response video ad or campaign you personally shaped. Explain the original signal or insight, the audience, the hook, the angle, the proof, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and your exact ownership.

Then show us how you use AI to search, organize, and turn a large body of source material into a stronger ad. We want to see the workflow and the finished result, not a list of tools.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

They translate this expertise into Market Requirements Documents that shape product roadmaps, go-to-market playbooks that guide commercial execution, and value propositions that give the sales organization a compelling story to tell.

Responsibilities:

Market Intelligence & VOC

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the assigned segment: customer workflows, buying behaviour, regulatory and compliance requirements, competitive landscape, and technology adoption trends

  • Conduct systematic competitive intelligence: tracking competitor product launches, pricing, application claims, and go-to-market moves — translating intelligence into actionable competitive response recommendations

Market Requirements Documents (MRDs)

  • Own the segment's Market Requirements Document — the structured, evidence-based articulation of customer needs, competitive gaps, and product investment priorities for the assigned segment across all relevant PerkinElmer product lines

  • Present MRD findings and recommendations to the VP Product Line teams, VP Marketing, and Sr. Director — defending investment priorities with customer evidence and commercial data, not assumption

  • Ensure MRD inputs are formally adopted into at least one VP Product Line roadmap planning cycle per year, tracking implementation of MRD-driven product decisions

  • Produce commercially actionable segment enablement tools: competitive battlecards, segment application guides, customer workflow maps, and sales playbooks that Regional Marketing Managers and the field sales organisation can deploy immediately

  • Partner with the Portfolio marketing team to brief and review segment-specific campaign content — ensuring technical accuracy, commercial relevance, and strategic alignment with the segment's priority themes

  • Drive annual growth planning for the assigned segment — identifying the highest-priority growth initiatives, the product line actions required to capture them, and the commercial resources needed to win

Thought Leadership & External Presence

  • Develop segment-specific thought leadership content: white papers, application note series themes, scientific conference presentations, and regulatory commentary that establishes PerkinElmer as a knowledgeable, credible voice in the segment

  • Represent PerkinElmer at segment-specific conferences, trade shows, and customer advisory events — speaking, networking, and gathering market intelligence

  • Contribute to PerkinElmer's customer advisory board programming for the segment — designing agendas, facilitating discussions, and translating advisory input into commercial and product management action

Success Metrics

  • MRD completion and adoption — annual MRD delivered on schedule and formally adopted in at least one VP Product Line roadmap planning cycle

  • VOC coverage — minimum 25 documented in-depth customer conversations per year

  • Segment growth contribution — revenue growth in the assigned segment vs. prior year and vs. market growth rate

  • Enablement asset quality and utilization — Portfolio marketing content briefed, commercial tools produced, and field adoption rate of segment playbooks and battlecards

  • Competitive win rate in the segment — tracked through win/loss analysis

Preferred

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Performance & Scalability
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test. You'll own performance and scalability across our platform, 30+ microservices, event-driven flows, and the legacy dependencies that come with a real production system at scale. This isn't a "run a load test before release" role. This is a role where you make performance a first-class concern from day one, where you define the thresholds that decide pass or fail, and where you hold the bar when something is degrading and nobody yet knows why.

You'll be the performance voice in every room you walk into, design discussions, architecture reviews, incident retrospectives. When latency spikes, you're already halfway through the trace. When a new service is being scoped, performance is already in the delivery plan because you put it there.

What you can expect to be doing:

  • Own Performance from Day One - You embed performance thinking into the delivery plan before code is written, not as an afterthought before release. You make performance testing a natural part of how teams build and ship — not a gate they hit at the end.

  • Define What Good Looks Like - You own the thresholds, metrics, and SLOs that govern pass or fail. You decide what a breach means, you set the budgets (latency, error rate, throughput), and you make those signals objective enough that a pipeline can act on them without a human reading graphs.

  • Test Services in Isolation, at Production Scale - You design and build performance tests for individual services, stubbing downstream and third-party dependencies so each journey is tested on its own merits. You map load to real production traffic to find where things bend and where they break.

  • Lead Performance in CI - You integrate performance testing into CI/CD so regressions are caught automatically, early, and fast. You own the fail-fast signals and keep them trustworthy.

  • Build Reusable, Scalable Assets - You build performance tests as code, reusable components, templates, and utilities that scale across teams and services. You handle data seeding and test setup so runs are repeatable and realistic.

  • Diagnose, Don't Just Report - You root-cause regressions across the stack, reading logs and tracing requests through distributed systems to find the source yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.

  • Reach Out and Drive Outcomes - You engage the right stakeholders, engineering, platform, product - to turn findings into fixes. You don't file a report and walk away; you drive the outcome.

  • Influence Decisions - You raise performance and scalability risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and bring people with you. When a design won't scale, you say so before it ships.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in performance engineering, with a track record of owning performance across complex, modern systems, not just executing someone else's load test.

  • Deep performance testing expertise. Hands-on experience designing realistic load models, running load, stress, soak and spike tests, and interpreting results meaningfully.

  • K6 or similar - You have real, hands-on depth with k6 for building and running performance tests.

  • Monitoring and observability know-how. You're comfortable with tools like Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar, and you use them proactively to correlate test results with what the system is actually doing, not just when something is already on fire.

  • Strong programming ability. You're extremely strong in at least one language. We use TypeScript across our stack; if your fundamentals are solid in another language, we're confident you'll pick it up fast.

  • Microservices and distributed systems. You understand service-oriented architectures, dependencies, and the realities of testing a service in isolation — stubbing, mocking, contract boundaries, as well as end-to-end.

  • CI/CD fluency - You've integrated performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and understand how to keep feedback fast and signals reliable. Experience with AWS infrastructure is strongly preferred.

  • Strong communication and presence. You participate fully in agile ceremonies and cross-team conversations. You don't sit quietly when something needs to be said

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, wealth management, or regulated financial services.

  • Experience using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate performance work.

  • Contributions to internal quality guilds, communities of practice, or engineering culture initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring engineers on performance and testing best practices.

What we’re really looking for: ✍️

Beyond the skills and the experience, we want someone who operates with ownership and independence. You don't wait for permission to improve something. You see a gap in coverage, a flaky test, a missing dashboard — and you fix it. You treat the Wealth Management experience line as yours, and you hold yourself to the same standard you hold the product to.

You're not a gatekeeper. You're a quality enabler. And you make every team you work with better at shipping reliable software.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply and tell us about a time you changed how quality worked on a team, not just what you tested, but how you made testing better for everyone around you.

  • Monday to Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Start your weekend early!)

Enjoy a structured yet balanced workweek, with an early Friday finish to kickstart your weekend!

PERKS🎁

  • Workplace pension scheme - We invest in your future with a workplace pension scheme, contributing 5% on earnings up to £50,000. Plan ahead with confidence while you grow your career! 🚀

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. jobs.excerpt: Wing is a fast-growing, Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed multinational startup.
jobs.description:
Wing is a fast-growing, Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed multinational startup.

We are looking for an exceptional, highly motivated individual to serve as a Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager - Pipeline & Delivery

The Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager – Pipeline & Delivery is responsible for the day-to-day management, visibility, and operational health of Wing's end-to-end client fulfillment pipeline.This role ensures that opportunities and accounts move efficiently through each stage of the business, from Sales handoff, talent requirements, recruitment and staffing, candidate presentation, client selection, onboarding, launch, and early account stabilization.

The Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager - Pipeline & Delivery serves as the central operational owner of the pipeline, continuously monitoring movement, identifying bottlenecks, enforcing timelines, coordinating cross-functional teams, and resolving process gaps that could delay revenue, staffing, or client activation.

This is not primarily an administrative tracking role. The position is expected to actively manage the pipeline, challenge stalled items, drive accountability, escalate risks, and improve the underlying processes that keep the pipeline moving.

Key Responsibilities

    1. End-to-End Pipeline Management

    • Own the daily operational management of Wing's active pipeline.
    • Maintain visibility across every account and requirement from Sales handoff through successful launch.
    • Ensure every pipeline item has a clear status, owner, next action, and expected completion date.
    • Monitor accounts that are stalled, delayed, blocked, or at risk.
    • Proactively follow up with responsible teams to move accounts forward.
    • Ensure pipeline stages accurately reflect the actual operational status of each account.

      2. Pipeline Health Monitoring

      • Conduct daily reviews of pipeline movement and outstanding requirements.
      • Identify aging accounts, stalled stages, capacity issues, and process bottlenecks.
      • Flag accounts at risk of missing staffing or launch timelines.
      • Monitor pipeline volume against available recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and operational capacity.
      • Maintain clear visibility into what is entering, moving through, and exiting the pipeline.

        3. Cross-Functional Coordination

        Work closely with:
        • Sales
        • Customer Success
        • Talent Acquisition
        • Staffing
        • Onboarding
        • Training
        • Operations
        • Product or specialized service teams
        • Finance and other support teams when required
        • Ensure clean handoffs between departments and prevent accounts from being delayed because of unclear ownership or incomplete information.

          4. Sales-to-Operations Handoff

          • Review newly closed accounts and confirm that operational requirements are complete.
          • Validate role requirements, client expectations, staffing needs, timelines, and special conditions.
          • Identify incomplete, unrealistic, or unclear requirements before they create downstream delays.
          • Coordinate with Sales when clarification or expectation resetting is required.
          • Ensure specialized products or services follow the correct operational process.

            5. Staffing and Candidate Pipeline Oversight

            • Monitor recruitment and staffing progress against client requirements.
            • Track candidate availability, endorsement, interviews, client selections, replacements, and pending decisions.
            • Identify roles with insufficient candidate supply or prolonged staffing timelines.
            • Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and Staffing leadership on priority requirements.
            • Escalate accounts requiring intervention, sourcing adjustments, compensation review, or expectation management.

              6. Client Selection and Decision Management

              • Track candidates presented to clients and outstanding client decisions.
              • Ensure follow-ups occur within established timelines.
              • Identify accounts where client responsiveness is delaying fulfillment.
              • Coordinate with CSMs, OBS, Sales, or account owners when client intervention is required.
              • Maintain visibility into candidate rejection reasons and recurring selection barriers.

                7. Onboarding and Launch Readiness

                • Monitor accounts approaching onboarding and launch.
                • Confirm that staffing, documentation, equipment, access, training, schedules, and client requirements are ready.
                • Surface launch risks before they become client-facing issues.
                • Coordinate resolution between responsible departments.
                • Ensure accounts transition cleanly from pipeline management into normal account operations.

                  8. Pipeline Escalation Management

                  Serve as the first operational escalation point for pipeline-related issues. Examples include:
                  • Staffing delays
                  • Missing client requirements
                  • Candidate shortages
                  • Interview delays
                  • Client decision delays
                  • Incorrect Sales handoffs
                  • Compensation mismatches
                  • Training capacity concerns
                  • Onboarding blockers
                  • Ownership gaps
                  • System or CRM inaccuracies
                  • Accounts repeatedly moving backward in the pipeline
                  • Determine the appropriate owner, establish an action plan, and monitor the issue until resolution.

                    9. Pipeline Governance and Accountability

                    • Establish and enforce pipeline SLAs.
                    • Ensure teams update their respective pipeline stages consistently.
                    • Hold stakeholders accountable for overdue actions.
                    • Require clear next steps for every active account.
                    • Escalate repeated SLA breaches or operational blockers to leadership.
                    • Ensure pipeline meetings focus on decisions and corrective actions rather than status reporting alone.

                      10. Pipeline Reporting and Forecasting

                      Provide leadership with clear visibility into:
                      • Total active pipeline
                      • New accounts entering the pipeline
                      • Accounts staffed
                      • Accounts awaiting candidates
                      • Accounts awaiting client decisions
                      • Accounts scheduled for launch
                      • Aging by pipeline stage
                      • Average time spent per stage
                      • Staffing turnaround time
                      • Bottleneck trends
                      • At-risk accounts
                      • Projected launches
                      • Expected revenue activation
                      • Pipeline capacity and resource constraints
                      • Produce weekly and monthly pipeline health reports with clear recommendations and required leadership actions.

                        11. Process Improvement

                        • Continuously evaluate how accounts move through Wing's pipeline.
                        • Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, unclear ownership, and communication gaps.
                        • Design improved workflows and escalation protocols.
                        • Recommend automation opportunities.
                        • Partner with system owners to improve CRM and pipeline architecture.
                        • Standardize handoff requirements between departments.
                        • Document processes, SLAs, escalation paths, and ownership matrices.
                        • Measure whether process changes improve pipeline velocity and client experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in operations, program management, revenue operations, staffing operations, customer success operations, or similar environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex workflows involving multiple departments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfortable working with high-volume operational pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of SLAs, workflow management, escalation management, and process optimization.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and follow-through.

  • Ability to challenge teams constructively and drive accountability.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • Experience using CRM, project management, reporting, and workflow management platforms.

  • Ability to interpret operational data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Able to travel to the Philippines as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in BPO, outsourcing, staffing, recruitment, SaaS, or service-based organizations.

  • Experience managing client implementation or fulfillment pipelines.

  • Experience working across Sales, Recruitment, Customer Success, and Operations.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, Power BI, or similar systems

  • Experience designing SLAs, dashboards, workflow automation, or operational governance.

2. Project Management & Visibility

Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
  • Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.


What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. The Opportunity

This is a forward deployed engineering internship: engineering pointed directly at real workflow problems rather than at a backlog. You will sit close to the people who actually use our product, including customers and our own internal operators, find where the work breaks down, and build the scripts, integrations, and internal tools that fix it. The role suits someone who likes the practical half of engineering: shipping something small that removes a real bottleneck today, rather than a perfect abstraction that lands next quarter. You will need to be comfortable with ambiguity, because the problem is often not defined before you go looking at it.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain internal tools, scripts, and automations that solve real operational bottlenecks.
  • Work with APIs, data pipelines, and integrations between systems, including debugging them when they misbehave.

  • Investigate data quality problems and trace them back to their source.
  • Explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical teammates.

Requirements

  • Strong coding fundamentals in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or a similar language.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-engineers.

  • Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly and is completely comfortable spending the majority of the workday managing communications via phone and text
  • Highly accountable and proactive: takes extreme ownership of cases, obsesses over the client experience, closes the loop, and acts as a creative problem solver when escalations arise
  • Tech-savvy and highly organized: easily works across multiple systems to piece together context and effectively triage daily priorities
  • Energized by the mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it

Bonus Points

jobs.excerpt: About bunny. netSome people accept the internet as it is.
jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

Senior Engineering Manager

Making the internet hop faster takes great teams, clear direction, and leaders who know when to challenge, when to support, and when to get out of the way.

That’s where you come in.

You’ll lead three areas shaping how we build and deliver a better internet:

  • Storage: with S3 now part of the platform, new use cases are opening up. You’ll help us capture that opportunity while evolving Storage to be more distributed and resilient at scale.

  • Stream: already a successful and strong revenue-generating product with plenty of room to grow. Stream relies heavily on Storage to store and serve video, so you’ll help both teams make smart decisions across architecture, scale, and growth.

  • Frontend: where our products come together for customers. You’ll help shape what using bunny.net feels like, while building reusable foundations that let teams ship polished experiences faster.

You’ll lead through engineering leads, but you won’t lead from the sidelines. You’ll stay close enough to the technology, products, and people to ask the right questions, unblock hard decisions, and help teams do their best work.

There’s a lot to own, a lot to improve, and plenty we haven’t imagined yet. If that sounds exciting, we’d love to build it with you.

What will you do?

  • Set the direction for Storage, Stream, and Frontend: what we build, why it matters, and what success looks like for the business

  • Lead and grow the teams across all three areas, with responsibility for both product and engineering, as our products and ambitions grow

  • Coach and grow engineering leads, and help more people step into bigger ownership

  • Go deep when it matters, helping teams work through tough architecture decisions and technical trade-offs

  • Keep the engineering bar high across reliability, scalability, security, and production operations within your teams, and help raise standards across engineering

  • Build planning and delivery habits that help teams ship fast without burning out or getting lost in the process

  • Be the go-to engineering voice for your teams, partnering with Growth, Support, senior leadership, and other engineering teams to turn customer needs into clear priorities

  • Step in on the hardest moments (tradeoffs, incidents, strategy shifts) and bring clarity when things get messy

  • Know what’s working and what isn’t, using data and customer insights to guide priorities, engineering decisions, and growth

  • Use AI thoughtfully to help you and your teams move faster and do better work, while keeping judgment and ownership firmly with people

What will you bring?

  • Experience owning one or more products end-to-end, leading product and engineering from customer discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption, and growth

  • Experience leading multiple teams, while staying close enough to guide priorities and unblock hard decisions

  • Background in storage, streaming, CDN/edge, or developer platforms (or strong adjacent experience with the curiosity to go deep fast)

  • Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, architecture, and trade-offs

  • A knack for connecting engineering decisions to customer value, and thinking beyond shipping to adoption and growth

  • A developer experience mindset, with examples of improving tooling, platforms, or workflows

  • The ability to set a clear vision and bring people with you, making complex things simple and going deep when the conversation calls for it

  • A track record of giving clear feedback, setting high standards, and helping people grow into bigger ownership

  • Comfort moving without a playbook, getting to the root of problems, and making things happen

What will make us extra happy?

  • You’ve taken a product or platform from idea to launch and beyond, and know what it takes to turn something people build into something customers actually use

  • You’re metrics-aware and pragmatic: you measure what matters, and you don’t confuse dashboards with progress

  • You bring entrepreneurial energy, spot opportunities others might miss, and aren't afraid to try something new

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

  • Music on us: Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

jobs.description:
Location: Europe. Being in the UK, Germany or Sweden is a small plus for market proximity and occasional travel, but it is not a requirement.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches and develops market-leading pet and equestrian marketplaces globally. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and some of our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we are on a mission to transform this process by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through innovative technology. We are a driven and ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by top-tier investors such as Verdane. As a company, we have been profitable since our first year, meaning we do not rely on investor capital for our growth.

The opportunity

This is our first dedicated PR hire and it covers the whole group. Over the years, PMG has managed to reduce animal welfare issues on our platforms far below any peer, through ID verification of breeders, AI-assisted moderation of adverts, a zero-tolerance approach to illegal puppy imports and unlicensed high-volume breeding, and by going far beyond what the law requires. Your job is to tell the world about it.

We know the playbook works because we have already done it once. In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling. You bring an AI-forward mindset, the instinct to ask how can I leverage myself through AI, and you use it daily for data analysis, drafting, localising, and getting a story out across markets, so covering seven markets does not mean seven times the work.

What you will do

  • Turn our marketplace data into publishable stories: pricing and demand trends, breed rankings, most popular puppy names, buyer surveys on preferences and the like. One shared instrument based on real-time data and identical core survey questions across markets.

  • Build and run the group editorial calendar, planned per market around seasonal hooks such as heatwaves, fireworks, International Puppy Day and so on, so we are ready before the news cycle asks.

  • Own our trust and safety transparency reporting: listings blocked, scams intercepted, buyer money protected, illegal import patterns by origin, for distribution to journalists and animal welfare stakeholders alike.

  • Mine breeder reviews, Trustpilot and support conversations for the human stories regional press actually run.

  • Become PMG's press desk, so the journalist relationship belongs to PMG rather than to an agency.

  • Brief and equip country leads and founders as spokespeople: talking points, Q&A, data appendices, prep before interviews.

Requirements

Must-have experience

  • 5+ years in PR, communications or journalism, preferably in-house, with coverage in national or major regional media that you personally landed. Data journalism experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of building stories out of data rather than distributing press releases. You can spot the angle a journalist will want before they ask, and you are comfortable enough with spreadsheets and dashboards to find it yourself and sanity check a number before a reporter does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, drafting, localisation and workflow automation. You think in terms of how to leverage yourself through AI, not around it, with a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Native-level English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a journalist.

  • Able to operate as a team of one: briefing agencies and freelancers and holding them to account, rather than managing staff beneath you.

Preferable experience

  • Experience in a reputation-exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, gambling, fintech or the gig economy, or in a category under active regulatory or campaigner scrutiny.

  • Experience running consumer surveys with panels or survey tools.

  • Digital PR fundamentals: earned links, newsjacking, syndication.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands-on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • A function that does not exist yet, yours to design, across seven markets, with a proven UK playbook to build from.

  • A proprietary dataset covering millions of pet and horse transactions that no journalist can get anywhere else.

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Galileo is transforming how America's workforce experiences healthcare, and we need an exceptional enterprise sales leader to accelerate our expansion. A Day in the Life

You'll spend significant time developing your strategy—researching target accounts, mapping stakeholder landscapes, nurturing broker/consultant relationships, and orchestrating multi-threaded sales campaigns that position Galileo ahead of competitors. Equally important is the consultative aspect of the role: you'll lead discovery conversations with CFOs, CHROs, and benefits teams to diagnose their healthcare challenges, architect custom solutions, and build business cases that survive executive scrutiny.   • Own and build: Develop and execute a multi-year account acquisition strategy for your assigned region/vertical, creating multiple pipeline sources including direct outreach, broker/consultant partnerships, and market trigger identification

  • Deliver consultative solutions: Lead structured discovery to uncover employer pain points, translate clinical outcomes into financial ROI, and design deal structures that overcome budget and timing obstacles
  • Forecast and report accurately: Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene in Salesforce, provide reliable monthly/quarterly revenue forecasts, and create comprehensive deal documentation that enables seamless cross-functional execution
  • Contribute market intelligence: Serve as a feedback loop to product, marketing, and leadership on competitive dynamics, messaging effectiveness, and emerging customer needs based on frontline insights
  • Ensure successful client launches: Partner with Operations, Finance, Legal, and Client Services throughout the deal lifecycle to align on implementation requirements, success KPIs, and long-term account strategy

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience with documented quota attainment in complex, long-cycle environments
  • 10+ years specifically selling to HR/benefits decision-makers in enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees preferred)
  • Proven track record closing multiple deals with annual contract values of $500K+ (must provide specific examples)

  • Experience managing 12+ month sales cycles with seasonal buying patterns and navigating complex procurement processes
  • Ability to travel approximately 50% and authorization to work in the United States

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You're a market developer, not an order-taker: You've created non-traditional pipeline sources (like partnerships that generated 40%+ of opportunities), identified market triggers before competitors, and developed sophisticated territory strategies beyond basic segmentation
  • You excel at stakeholder orchestration: You've successfully recovered deals after initial rejection by re-engaging through different stakeholders, and you naturally adapt your pitch for CFOs (financial impact), CHROs (employee experience), and clinical leaders (quality outcomes)

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Spain
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Spain.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

jobs.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Where you sit.

You'll be joining the Origination stream, the product area responsible for the end-to-end mortgage journey, covering self-serve and advisor-supported application flows, underwriting, decisioning, and funding.

This is a Senior PM role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own your specific substream within origination. You'll work closely with the stream lead, and together you'll define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team's needs, and where the biggest opportunities are. It's a rare chance to have real influence over your own scope from day one.

Your closest collaborators will be engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, mortgage operations and underwriting experts who live inside these processes daily, and the brokers and advisors who depend on these tools to serve clients.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Act as one of the primary origination subject-matter experts for your substream, deeply understanding end-to-end origination processes, regulatory requirements, and operational realities.
  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real-world origination requirements, operational efficiencies, and compliance considerations.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new lending features, regulatory changes, and origination workflow evolutions to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, and compliance to validate designs and proposed solutions, ensuring they align with origination best practices and industry standards.
  • Support the backlog refinement process by prioritizing origination-related epics and stories, balancing customer experience, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Participate in release planning, UAT, and pre-launch readiness to ensure origination use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, evolving regulations, origination technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights to guide product evolution.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of origination processes, scenarios, requirements, and system behaviours to support product teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Act as the go-to expert for your origination workflows, answering questions, supporting issue triage, and ensuring the product supports exceptional origination experiences across all lending products.

AI-Augmented Ways of Working

  • Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others) to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery: synthesizing research, prototyping ideas, and measuring results.
  • Don't wait for a perfect process to test a hypothesis. Use the tools available to you to get to answers faster, whether that means building a rough prototype, running a quick experiment, or drafting a solution to pressure-test with users before it becomes a roadmap item.
  • Comfortable going beyond traditional PM boundaries when the situation calls for it, the best people here don't hand off and wait, they stay close to the work and use every tool at their disposal to move it forward.
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap.
  • Share what you discover. How you work should make the people around you better.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The profile.

  • 5-7+ years of hands-on experience in product management, ideally with exposure to mortgage origination, lending, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
  • Understanding of end-to-end origination functions from application flows, document collection, underwriting, credit decisioning to compliance checkpoints, and funding processes.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance requirements, and reporting obligations.
  • Experience working with origination platforms, LOS systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into functional system requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, and QA teams.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with an ability to anticipate downstream impacts and foresee edge cases in origination workflows.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex origination concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow : discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.

PREFERRED BUT NOT A MUST

  • Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
  • Familiarity with broker and advisor-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self-serve client journeys.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context.

YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF
Be honest with yourself.

  • You're only comfortable in a well-defined product area. This role requires you to help shape your own scope: ambiguity is the starting condition, not an exception.
  • You treat AI tools as a curiosity rather than a daily accelerant.
  • You hand off a PRD and consider your job done. Ownership here runs from discovery all the way through to measuring results in production.
  • You don't thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • You are not open to experimentation and continuous improvement.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to ensure loan files move efficiently from submission through closing.

You also own the disciplined execution that turns those frameworks into programs that run on time across a distributed, matrixed, multi-brand environment.

This role sits within KinderCare’s newly formed Enterprise Center of Excellence, Talent Strategy & Elevation, working directly with the VP as a strategic thought partner and execution engine. The full talent portfolio runs through this role: performance management, talent reviews, succession and pipeline, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness. This is a build role — systems aren't complete, calendars aren't consistent, and standards need to be set. TALENT STRATEGY CO-OWNERSHIP

  • Partner with the VP, Talent Strategy & Elevation to architect the enterprise talent management strategy (philosophy, governance model, and multi-year roadmap) and evolve it based on outcomes data

  • Represent this function in cross-functional settings and serve as an extension of the VP with HRBPs, L&D, and HR Operations partners

PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Co-design and operationalize the enterprise performance management framework — structure, rating philosophy, calibration process design, and governance

  • Build the annual calibration process and manager toolkits, partnering with HRBPs who lead field delivery and with L&D on manager capability building

  • Govern PIP and coaching standards for consistency across brands, in partnership with HRBPs and Employee Relations

  • Own performance outcomes analytics: distribution, manager compliance, and correlation to attrition, mobility, and business results

  • Maintain and enhance HRIS talent modules in partnership with HR Operations and Principal Talent Program Manager

TALENT REVIEWS & CALIBRATION

  • Architect and govern the enterprise talent review process — calibration methodology, assessment framework (6-box), readiness ratings, and talent segmentation criteria

  • Design the facilitation approach and calibration guides alongside L&D partners

  • Own hi-potential identification criteria and program design, collaborating with L&D on development programming

  • Define program efficacy metrics and run measurement and success criteria

SUCCESSION & PIPELINE

  • Build and own the succession planning methodology: successor identification criteria, readiness laddering, depth targets, and development plan integration

  • Drive documentation of critical-role succession plans with depth ratings and clear development linkage

  • Drive internal mobility strategy and governance, defining how movement happens across brands and corporate functions and moving the needle on cross-brand mobility and career velocity

  • Design career pathing frameworks for key role families and coordinate with HRBPs on field-level implementation

WORKFORCE PLANNING & ORGANIZATIONAL EFFECTIVENESS

  • Serve as the talent voice in enterprise workforce planning: connect succession depth, skills gap analysis, and readiness data to the organization's 1–3 year workforce plan

  • Partner with HRBPs on spans-and-layers analysis and organizational effectiveness diagnostics

  • Apply OE frameworks to measure people program efficacy across the CoE portfolio — not just whether programs ran, but whether they moved outcomes

PROGRAM OPERATIONS & ENTERPRISE CALENDAR

  • Accountable for the enterprise talent calendar — performance, succession, and talent review cycles — anticipating conflicts, advocating for sequencing, and driving cross-functional readiness; Talent Program Manager responsible for driving calendar and project plans

  • Lead program launch governance in partnership with the Principal Talent Program Manager: stakeholder alignment, readiness checks, communication cadence, and post-launch retrospectives

FIELD & BRAND ENGAGEMENT

Omilia is a leader in Conversational AI. Omilia is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise and mid-market implementations of Omilia's conversational solutions for contact centers, including Omilia's Agentic AI Solutions. ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Job Description

Are you a compassionate, organized, and relationship-focused nurse who loves helping people find their way through the healthcare system? As a Care Connection Nurse Navigator, you’ll be a trusted advocate and primary point of contact for patients as they connect with care across the organization.

This role is focused on helping new patients establish primary care, connecting patients with the right services, and making every step of their healthcare experience as seamless as possible. You’ll combine clinical knowledge with exceptional customer service to coordinate appointments, navigate referrals, identify barriers to care, provide education and support, and connect patients with the resources they need to achieve their best possible outcomes.

You’ll work closely with physicians, nurses, clinical teams, and non-clinical staff throughout the organization to build strong relationships and create solutions that work for both patients and care teams. You’ll also help strengthen connections between patients and the organization by promoting available services, supporting access to myUHealth, and proactively identifying opportunities to keep patients engaged in their care.

What You’ll Bring (Minimum Requirements)

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent combination of an Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) and relevant experience.

  • Current Missouri Registered Nurse (RN) license.

  • Minimum of three years of experience working in a healthcare setting.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to read and speak the English language.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Current BCLS certification.

  • Ability to develop and maintain strong knowledge of healthcare resources and services available within the organization and through community health-related organizations.

  • Ability to maintain a calm and professional demeanor in a demanding, high-stress environment while consistently demonstrating sound judgment, exceptional customer service, and strong problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to handle patient concerns and sensitive information with tact, professionalism, and confidentiality.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural, socioeconomic, and professional backgrounds.

  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently as an autonomous self-starter and collaboratively as a team player.

  • Professional appearance and presentation.

What You’ll Do

Be a Trusted Patient Advocate

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for referred and newly engaged patients throughout their healthcare experience.

  • Proactively reach out to patients who are not yet established with primary care and help connect them with the appropriate provider and services.

  • Answer incoming calls, accurately identify patient needs, and guide patients to the appropriate area of care or service.

  • Schedule physician appointments and help patients understand what to expect before, during, and after their visits.

  • Verify insurance information and ensure required pre-certifications and authorizations are obtained and appropriately documented.

  • Explain organizational policies and procedures in a clear, helpful, and patient-friendly manner.

  • Make appointment reminder calls and proactively schedule future appointments when appropriate.

  • Greet and guide patients to the appropriate areas of care and assist with questions related to billing information.

Coordinate Care Across the Healthcare System

  • Assess patients’ medical needs and help coordinate care across multiple settings and services.

  • Track laboratory and imaging results and notify patients of normal and abnormal results according to established protocols.

  • Provide timely clinical advice by telephone and electronic messaging during and after office hours, within the scope of practice and established protocols.

  • Coordinate referrals and track patients throughout the referral process to help ensure care is completed without unnecessary delays.

  • Facilitate the exchange of clinical information during inpatient hospitalizations.

  • Provide telephonic or face-to-face follow-up with patients within 72 hours of emergency department or inpatient discharge.

  • Promote continuity of care by helping patients move smoothly between primary care, specialty care, inpatient, outpatient, and community services.

  • Provide direct clinic patient care as needed based on department priorities, staffing, and patient volumes.

Remove Barriers & Connect Patients to Resources

  • Work collaboratively with clinical and non-clinical team members to identify barriers that may prevent patients from accessing or completing care.

  • Develop solutions and connect patients with appropriate organizational and community resources.

  • Build and maintain strong knowledge of healthcare resources and services available within the organization and throughout the community.

  • Provide patient education, outreach, encouragement, and ongoing support to promote successful engagement in care.

  • Help patients navigate and make the most of myUHealth and other available tools and services.

  • Promote awareness of preventative care, wellness services, and other healthcare resources available through the organization and University Health.

  • Look for opportunities to proactively connect patients with services that can support their health and well-being.

Build Relationships & Deliver Exceptional Service

  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with physicians, support staff, clinical teams, and non-clinical personnel throughout the organization.

  • Partner with providers and staff to accommodate patient needs, support access to care, and contribute to organizational patient volumes.

  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, communication, relationship-building, and team-building skills.

  • Practice cultural competency and adapt communication and support to meet the needs of diverse patients and families.

  • Create a culture of exemplary customer service and responsive, patient-centered care.

  • Ensure care is compassionate, coordinated, and respectful of each patient’s preferences, values, and individual needs.

  • Consistently demonstrate a calm, professional, courteous, and helpful demeanor, even in demanding or high-stress situations.

  • Handle patient concerns and sensitive information with tact, professionalism, confidentiality, and sound judgment.

Document, Track & Improve

  • Accurately document patient services and interactions in the electronic medical record.

  • Track and manage data related to the patient navigation program to demonstrate outcomes and monitor service quality.

  • Generate reports related to patient navigation program performance as requested by the manager or designee.

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives designed to enhance patient access, service, safety, and outcomes.

  • Promote staff and patient safety and cultural diversity through daily operations and personal performance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and find more effective ways to support patients and care teams.

Bring Flexibility & Leadership to the Team

  • Adapt to changing priorities, accept new assignments, and approach new challenges with flexibility and enthusiasm.

  • Look for opportunities to learn new skills, improve workflows, and help others learn new tasks.

  • Evaluate and maintain nursing practice in accordance with professional standards, guidelines, applicable statutes, rules, regulations, and organizational expectations.

  • Provide age-appropriate service and demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to meet patients’ physical, psychosocial, educational, and safety needs.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Compliance & Professional Excellence

  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable statutes, regulations, guidelines, and standards necessary to perform job responsibilities.

  • Comply with the organization’s Code of Conduct, Corporate Compliance Plan, and Compliance Policies and Procedures, including all required training.

  • Participate in compliance activities under the direction of the Department Manager and Corporate Compliance Officer.

  • Consistently represent the organization with professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to patient-centered care.
