jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request as required by applicable law and company policy. Any information received relating to accommodations will be treated as confidential.

jobs.description:
AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title

Software Engineer Technical Lead

Position Location

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

ai2io is seeking a Software Engineer Technical Lead with deep C#/.NET, Microsoft Azure, and ASP.NET Blazor experience to own the technical direction and engineering outcomes of a software team. Blazor is our strategic web-application platform. You will remain a hands-on contributor while guiding architecture, delivery, production readiness, secure engineering, and team capability across our Microsoft-centric stack.

The current application portfolio also includes React applications that ai2io must responsibly maintain while planning and executing their transition to C#/.NET and Blazor. Strong React and TypeScript experience is therefore important for sustaining business continuity, stabilizing inherited applications, understanding their behavior and dependencies, and leading deliberate migrations without disrupting users or critical workflows. This role is not intended to establish React as a long-term parallel platform.

Experience with Revit, electrical or mechanical engineering, BIM, MEP workflows, or the broader architecture, engineering, and construction industry is valuable because many ai2io products support specialized engineering work, but that domain experience is not required.

Essential Functions

This role combines hands-on leadership of the strategic .NET and Blazor platform with accountable stewardship of transitional React applications, including their reliable operation and planned conversion.

Own Technical Direction for the Strategic Platform

  • Serve as the team's primary technical decision-maker for solutions built with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Blazor, Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Lead design for new features and systems and guide teams toward C#/.NET and Blazor for ongoing development unless an approved exception is warranted.
  • Produce durable architecture decision records, system diagrams, API contracts, migration guidance, and implementation plans that engineers can execute against.
  • Define and enforce coding standards, pull-request practices, definition of done, automated testing expectations, accessibility, documentation, and the engineering quality bar.
  • Remain hands-on in production C#, Blazor, Azure, and targeted React/TypeScript work where continuity, diagnosis, or migration risk requires direct contribution.

Maintain Transitional React Applications

  • Own the technical health of React applications while ai2io is responsible for their continued operation, including defect resolution, dependency updates, security findings, diagnostics, testing, and production support.
  • Quickly assess inherited React applications, documenting architecture, build and deployment processes, dependencies, data flows, integrations, ownership gaps, operational risks, and critical business workflows.
  • Prioritize stabilization work that protects users and business continuity without expanding avoidable long-term investment in the transitional React platform.
  • Establish sufficient React and TypeScript coding, testing, review, and release practices to maintain inherited applications safely through their remaining lifecycle.
  • Identify unsupported, fragile, or high-risk components early and present clear mitigation and migration options.

Lead React-to-Blazor Conversion

  • Create phased migration strategies that move React applications and workflows to C#/.NET and Blazor while preserving user outcomes, data integrity, integrations, and operational continuity.
  • Decide what should be migrated, redesigned, consolidated, retired, or temporarily retained based on business value, technical risk, maintainability, usage, and migration cost.
  • Decompose migrations into controlled increments with coexistence boundaries, interface contracts, acceptance criteria, rollback plans, and explicit cutover checkpoints.
  • Partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and users to validate functional parity and identify where migration is an opportunity to simplify or improve the experience rather than reproduce unnecessary complexity.
  • Retire superseded React components and dependencies after verified cutover, ensuring documentation, monitoring, support ownership, and source repositories reflect the final state.

Plan and Coordinate Technical Delivery

  • Break complex features and migrations into coherent increments, identifying technical discovery, dependencies, sequencing constraints, integration risks, and milestones before commitments are finalized.
  • Own technical feasibility, decomposition, estimates, dependencies, execution health, and technical risk behind team commitments; partner with the Project Manager on the integrated schedule, stakeholder communication, scope coordination, and overall delivery process.
  • Coordinate engineers through purposeful delegation, design checkpoints, code review, blocker removal, and clear implementation direction.
  • Communicate business-continuity and migration tradeoffs clearly, bringing evidence and recommended options rather than status alone.

Own Azure Production Readiness

  • Own team-level readiness for Azure-hosted releases, including deployment planning, observability, diagnostics, rollback considerations, support documentation, and resolution of material technical risks.
  • Guide appropriate use of Azure application, data, identity, integration, storage, secrets, and monitoring services in alignment with organizational standards.
  • Lead investigation of significant production issues across Blazor and transitional React applications, coordinating mitigation, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements.

Tagetik is seeking a highly commercial and growth-oriented Global Head of Inside Sales to lead and scale its global SDR and BDR organisation.

The role will own the global Inside Sales strategy, operating model and performance, with responsibility for building predictable pipeline, improving sales productivity and increasing the contribution of Inside Sales to revenue growth.

Working closely with Direct Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Product and Customer Success, the Global Head of Inside Sales will turn market opportunity into qualified pipeline and revenue through scalable inbound and outbound sales motions.

The successful candidate will combine strong SaaS commercial leadership with operational rigour and a proven ability to build and lead high-performing global teams through growth, transformation and change. They will also be a strong advocate for the use of AI and emerging technologies to improve prospecting, productivity and commercial effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Global Strategy & Commercial Impact

  • Define and execute the global Inside Sales strategy in alignment with Tagetik's business and go-to-market priorities.
  • Shape Inside Sales contribution to annual planning, market segmentation, territory design, coverage models and growth initiatives.
  • Drive predictable pipeline and revenue growth through effective customer acquisition and demand-conversion strategies.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and commercial KPIs across the global organisation.
  • Provide data-driven insights, recommendations and performance updates to the Global Sales Leadership Team and senior executives.
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of the Inside Sales organisation and identify opportunities to improve scale, productivity and commercial impact.

Pipeline Generation & Demand Conversion

  • Build and optimise scalable inbound and outbound SDR/BDR motions across regions, segments and markets.
  • Improve meeting creation, opportunity conversion, pipeline velocity and progression from marketing-qualified leads to qualified sales opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to improve lead quality, campaign performance, demand generation and lead hand-offs.
  • Develop and scale account-based prospecting strategies for strategic and high-value accounts.
  • Establish strong alignment between SDR/BDR teams and Account Executives to maximise conversion, follow-through and revenue generation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from initial engagement through to sales opportunity.

Global Team Leadership & Talent

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing global SDR and BDR organisation across multiple geographies.
  • Build a culture of accountability, execution, continuous improvement and customer engagement.
  • Develop strong management capability and create clear succession plans across the organisation.
  • Own capacity planning, workforce planning, headcount allocation and alignment of Inside Sales resources with field sales coverage.
  • Attract, retain and develop high-calibre commercial talent across the global organisation.
  • Establish clear career development pathways, including opportunities for high-performing SDR/BDR employees to progress into Field Sales roles.
  • Lead organisational transformation and change initiatives that improve performance and scalability.

Operating Excellence, Technology & AI

  • Establish a consistent global operating model covering processes, KPIs, forecasting, reporting and performance management.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve data quality, performance visibility, forecasting accuracy and commercial decision-making.
  • Use analytics and performance data to identify productivity opportunities and improve return on commercial investment.
  • Accelerate adoption of AI-enabled prospecting, research, engagement, automation and sales-enablement technologies.
  • Evaluate emerging sales technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve productivity, scale and effectiveness.
  • Establish best practices and ensure consistent execution across regions while allowing for appropriate local market requirements.
  • Stay current with developments in SaaS selling, digital engagement, AI and modern revenue-generation practices and translate relevant innovation into practical improvements.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Channel Management, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product and Customer Success to align pipeline generation with broader go-to-market priorities.
  • Work closely with Field Sales leadership to ensure effective territory alignment, account coverage and pipeline conversion.
  • Represent Inside Sales in strategic business reviews, annual planning and growth initiatives.
  • Communicate performance, opportunities, risks and actions clearly to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor on pipeline generation, sales productivity and scalable revenue growth.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • 10+ years' experience in B2B SaaS, technology, software, information services or other subscription-based businesses.
  • Proven experience leading Inside Sales, Sales Development, Business Development or broader commercial sales organisations.
  • Significant experience leading global, multi-region teams, including both managers and individual contributors.
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable improvements in pipeline generation, revenue contribution and sales productivity.
  • Experience building, scaling or transforming a global Inside Sales/SDR/BDR capability.
  • Strong understanding of modern SaaS go-to-market strategies, demand conversion and digital sales engagement.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience of AI-enabled GTM tools and their application to prospecting, research, engagement and sales productivity.
  • Strong analytical and operational capabilities, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities, make decisions and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to develop high-performing teams, strengthen leadership capability and create effective talent pipelines.
  • Strong commercial judgement, strategic thinking and the ability to translate strategy into measurable execution.
  • Experience operating effectively in a complex, matrixed global organisation.
  • Comfortable leading transformation, managing change and challenging established ways of working.
  • Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with the credibility to operate effectively with senior commercial and executive leadership.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Salesforce Architecture, Integration and Data Assessor
jobs.excerpt: Remote role Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.
jobs.description:
Remote role

Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.

This is an assessment engagement, not an implementation. You will not build, configure, integrate, remediate, or operate anything. You will examine what has already been built, review the evidence, interview the people who built it, and reach independent, defensible conclusions for executive leadership. Independence from the program's implementation vendors is a contractual requirement of the engagement.

The scope covers nine assessment domains and 65 discrete assessment requirements: program governance and risk, business process alignment, architecture and design, integration and data management, mainframe and legacy modernization, security and privacy compliance, software development lifecycle and configuration management, testing and quality assurance, and operational readiness. The technology environment includes a major cloud customer relationship management platform, a public cloud infrastructure estate, an enterprise integration platform, a content management platform, intelligent document processing, and a mainframe lift-and-refactor migration.

Deliverables include an assessment management plan, an initial assessment report, recurring status briefings, per-domain assessment reports, readiness assessments, an executive briefing, and a final assessment report.
You will work full time for four months in a small paired-team structure alongside senior peers. Findings go directly to executive leadership and to a legislative oversight body.

Required

  • 10 or more years in enterprise architecture or solution architecture
  • Salesforce governance depth — data model, security and sharing model, configuration governance, release governance, and adherence to platform best practices. We need someone who can judge whether a Salesforce environment was governed well, not someone who wants to build one.
  • MuleSoft or a comparable integration platform — application programming interface (API) lifecycle management, error handling, interface design, and API security. This category is often called iPaaS, meaning integration platform as a service.
  • Data migration and conversion assessment — source-to-target mapping, data cleansing, reconciliation controls, and data quality frameworks
  • Reporting and analytics readiness assessment
  • Can evaluate scalability, maintainability, extensibility, and supportability and write the conclusion up defensibly

About Us: Sabot Consulting is a management consulting company focused on providing technical and management consulting to IT executives and managers in strategic, operational, and project-based practice areas. Our focus on providing expert staff that have the knowledge, experience, and professionalism to engage the client at all levels is the key to our success.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager Tax Reporting

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen's Tax Reporting group is part of a world-class tax department that provides global tax planning, transfer pricing, tax reporting, and tax audit defense for the Company. The Tax Reporting team is a critical function providing advice on tax accounting, tax rate forecasting, and the financial statement tax provision process. The group works closely with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax Planning, Regional Tax, Transfer Pricing, and Tax Audit teams to prepare Amgen's financial statement tax provision and support U.S. federal, state, and U.S. International tax compliance.

The Senior Manager, Tax Reporting will report to the Tax Associate Director and will focus on two core areas: ASC 740 and U.S. International tax provision and compliance. This role will serve as a technical resource for ASC 740 matters, lead assigned components of the quarterly and annuals income tax provision, and help ensure material tax matters are identified, documented, and reflected accurately in financial reporting deliverables. The role will also review and analyze U.S. International tax provision and compliance matters, including topics such as GILTI, FDII, BEAT, foreign tax credits, Subpart F, Section 986(c), earnings and profits, and related international reporting requirements. This role will also support Domestic tax matters and special projects as needed.

The ideal candidate will have strong tax accounting knowledge, practical experience with U.S. International tax compliance and provision processes, keen analytical skills, and the ability to communicate technical tax concepts clearly to tax and non-tax stakeholders. Experience with OneSource Tax Provision is preferred, and experience with OneSource Income Tax or similar compliance technology is helpful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead assigned components of the quarterly and annual income tax provision process, including preparation and review of selected provision calculations, journal entries, account analyses, disclosures, and supporting workpapers.
  • Serve as a technical reference point for ASC 740 questions, helping the team research, document, and apply tax accounting guidance to recurring and non-routine matters.
  • Assist with the identification and analysis of material provision items, including uncertain tax positions, valuation allowance considerations, tax law changes, acquisitions and divestitures, audit developments, transfer pricing matters, and tax planning initiatives.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director of Tax and relevant tax stakeholders to identify, analyze, and appropriately reflect material tax matters within assigned area.
  • Coordinate and support assigned aspects of the international tax provision process, including review and analysis of foreign affiliate tax packages, local provision inputs, deferred tax matters, return-to-provision adjustments, and related documentation.
  • Review and analyze U.S. international tax compliance calculations and reporting, including GILTI, FDII, foreign tax credits, Subpart F, BEAT, Section 986(c), earnings and profits & PTEP.
  • Lead quarterly GILTI deferred tax accounting and reconciliations.
  • Collaborate with Regional Tax, Transfer Pricing, Tax Planning, Tax Audit, Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and external service providers to understand business transactions and data flows that impact Amgen's provision and tax returns.
  • Prepare and review memoranda or other documentation supporting conclusions for technical tax accounting, U.S. International tax, and non-routine matters.
  • Help maintain SOX-compliant processes and audit-ready workpapers for assigned provision and international tax areas.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and control enhancements within assigned provision and international tax workstreams.
  • Provide technical guidance, review comments, training, and day-to-day support to tax professionals on ASC 740 and U.S. International tax matters.
  • Complete special projects and support other Tax Reporting initiatives as needed.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a project leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of analytics experience in Tax Reporting

OR

  • Master’s degree and 4 years of analytics experience in Tax Reporting

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of analytics experience in Tax Reporting

OR

  • Associate’s degree and 10 years of analytics experience in Tax Reporting

OR

  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of analytics experience in Tax Reporting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher
  • CPA, MST, JD, LLM, or other relevant advanced tax or accounting credential.
  • 8+ years of tax experience with a strong emphasis on ASC 740 and tax reporting for a large multinational publicly traded company.
  • Public accounting experience preferred
  • Practical experience with both provision and compliance for international tax, including GILTI, FDII, foreign tax credits, Subpart F, Section 986(c), earnings and profits, BEAT, PTEP and Forms 5471, 8858, 8865, 8990, 8991, 8992, 8993.
  • Strong U.S. GAAP background.
  • Experience reviewing or preparing international tax calculations, return-to-provision analyses, deferred tax balances, and audit-ready supporting documentation.
  • Experience with OneSource Tax Provision; experience with OneSource Income Tax, SAP, Alteryx, or other tax technology tools is a plus.
  • Strong research and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical tax conclusions clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional team environment and communicate effectively across multiple levels of management.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage deadlines, competing priorities, and multiple stakeholders during provision and compliance cycles.
  • Proactive ownership, collaborative problem-solving approach, sound judgment, positive attitude, strong work ethic and the ability to operate effectively during time-sensitive reporting cycles
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or high-tech industry is helpful.

Key Capabilities

  • Technical depth in ASC 740 with the judgment to identify when matters require elevation to the Associate Director or other tax leadership.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. International tax rules and related compliance mechanics, with enough experience to review calculations, ask effective questions, and connect provision impacts to return positions.
  • Translate complex tax concepts into clear implications for Tax Reporting and cross-functional stakeholders, with appropriate escalation to tax leadership.
  • Strong ownership mindset for assigned workstreams, including timely issue identification, clear escalation, and practical recommendations.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, controls, and sustainable tax reporting processes.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Applied Legal Benchmark Specialist
Type:Contract
Compensation:$83–$105/hour
Location:Remote
Commitment:10+ hours/week

Role Responsibilities

  • Author original law questions to test deep conceptual understanding, not surface-level recall.
  • Ensure questions are unambiguous, self-contained, and precisely defined with all necessary information in the problem statement.
  • Rate each question's difficulty: Medium (intro undergraduate), Hard (advanced undergraduate), or Expert (post-graduate and above).
  • Provide 1 correct answer and 9 plausible but subtly incorrect alternatives to challenge expert-level solvers.
  • Write step-by-step Chain-of-Thought solutions with clear, concise reasoning in markdown format.
  • Supply 1–5 academic references per question from reputable sources like peer-reviewed journals and legal repositories.
  • For verification tasks: flag issues with clarity, completeness, precision, or solvability and justify any edits made.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions is a growing healthcare company that partners with medical practices to provide insurance-supported dietary and exercise counseling programs for patients.

Our model connects physicians and their patients with dietitians, virtual trainers, and operational support designed to improve patient engagement and continuity of care.

We are entering an important growth stage and are looking for a Business Development & Operations Lead who can help expand our physician partnerships while strengthening the operational systems and client experience supporting that growth.

This is not a traditional back-office Operations Manager position.

We are looking for someone who can operate as a trusted extension of the leadership team: part business developer, part client success leader, part operator, and part strategic problem solver.

What You Will Own

Physician Acquisition & Business Growth

A major priority for this role is helping Pillar Health Solutions grow its network of physician and medical-practice partners.

You will:

  • Develop and execute practical strategies for attracting new physician and clinic partnerships

  • Research new channels, tools, partnerships, and approaches for increasing qualified opportunities

You do not need to be a career marketer, but you should understand how businesses grow and be able to contribute thoughtful, executable ideas.

Discovery Calls & Client Conversion

Responsibilities will include:

  • Following up on opportunities and moving qualified prospects toward partnership

  • Continuously improving the discovery and conversion process based on feedback and results

Success in this position requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with physicians, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

Physician, Patient & Program Operations

Once partnerships are established, you will help ensure that the experience remains strong for physicians and patients.

You will:

  • Address service issues, complaints, and operational breakdowns

Because patient experience can directly affect program continuation and business performance, this role requires someone who notices problems early and acts on them.

Founder Partnership & Executive Communication

You will work closely with Pillar Health Solutions leadership and should be comfortable communicating directly with a founder.

Initially, this may include a short daily business update meeting.

You will be expected to:

  • Prepare and drive the agenda rather than waiting for leadership to determine what should be discussed

  • Provide respectful pushback when an idea may not be practical or when another priority should come first

We are looking for someone who can disagree professionally, communicate difficult information tactfully, and remain levelheaded under pressure.

AI & Technology Integration

You will:

  • Research tools independently when a business problem arises

  • Use AI for research, analysis, documentation, communication, marketing support, and process improvement

We are looking for practical AI literacy, not simply someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.

Operational Excellence

This may include:

  • Monitoring business and client KPIs

  • Improving workflows as operational gaps become visible

  • Maintaining accurate client, physician, patient, billing, and reporting information

  • Supporting consistent naming conventions and documentation

  • Reviewing processes for accuracy and efficiency

  • Creating or improving SOPs when a documented process is genuinely needed

  • Supporting scheduling, invoicing, reporting, and administrative coordination

  • Helping the company prepare operationally as the number of physician partners and patients increases

As Pillar grows, the scope of the position may expand into greater leadership and team-management responsibilities.

jobs.excerpt: Bring more to life. At Danaher, our work saves lives.
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact — innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we're committed to hiring and developing from within. You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

About the Diagnostics Platform

The Diagnostics Platform is one of Danaher's three global platforms, uniting a portfolio of leading operating companies whose work sits at the point of clinical decision — from the emergency room and intensive care unit to the pathology lab, the core hospital laboratory, the molecular diagnostics workstation, and the patient bedside. The technologies developed and delivered by these operating companies help clinicians detect cancer earlier, identify and manage infectious diseases ranging from tuberculosis and HIV to sepsis and respiratory infections, monitor critically ill and vulnerable patients continuously, and make faster, more confident decisions when time and accuracy save lives.

The platform has a global presence, with operating companies serving hospitals, clinical laboratories, and point-of-care settings on six continents. Its products are highly regulated connected medical devices and in vitro diagnostics (IVD) directly involved in acute-care and life-critical clinical decisions — making cybersecurity a patient-safety, regulatory, and brand-trust priority for the platform.

The Platform Information Security Officer (PISO), Diagnostics Platform is responsible for end-to-end cybersecurity execution across all operating companies (OpCos) within the Diagnostics Platform globally. As part of Danaher's global information security operating model — six central DIS Global Services pillars and identically structured DIS Platform Security Teams under each platform — this leader is the platform's senior-most cybersecurity executive and the operational counterpart to the Global CISO across a global conglomerate of OpCos.

The PISO enforces enterprise cyber standards across the Diagnostics OpCos, drives continuous improvement, and adapts the global program to the unique security needs of each OpCo's connected medical devices, clinical customers, regulatory obligations (including FDA premarket and postmarket medical device cybersecurity, EU IVDR, and IEC 81001-5-1 / IEC 62443), and manufacturing footprint.

This position reports to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and is part of the Global Information Security organization, located in Washington, D.C. and will be a remote role, with regular global travel required to Diagnostics OpCo sites.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Own end-to-end cybersecurity execution across all Diagnostics OpCos globally, translating Danaher's global cyber strategy, policies, and standards into measurable outcomes while serving as the platform's senior cybersecurity executive and single accountable face of cyber to OpCo Presidents, CIOs, R&D/product leaders, manufacturing site leaders, the CISO, and OpCo executive leadership.

  • Build, lead, and develop a globally distributed Platform Security Team spanning Security Architecture & Engineering, Technical Security Risk Management, Cyber Assurance Management, Data & AI Security, Cyber PMO, and Manufacturing Security, partnering in a matrixed model with the six DIS Global Services pillars to align platform execution to enterprise standards and central capabilities.

  • Own the Diagnostics Platform's cyber risk register, technical risk management, vulnerability management prioritization, remediation delivery, architecture review execution, integration and remediation engineering, and platform architecture standards that embed enterprise controls into OpCo enterprise systems, cloud environments, and connected medical device platforms.

  • Lead platform cyber assurance, including customer security questionnaires, audit response, ISO 27001, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other cybersecurity certification programs, serving as the single face to hospital, health system, and government-agency assessors.

  • Coordinate with the central Product Security function on FDA premarket cybersecurity, postmarket vulnerability management, SBOM, and PSIRT operations for Diagnostics OpCos' connected medical devices and IVD instruments, including requirements under Section 524B of the FD&C Act and other applicable regulatory expectations.

  • Drive cyber diligence, integration, and day-1 through steady-state onboarding when Diagnostics OpCos acquire new business units, while leading data protection, AI security governance coordination, application security engineering, secrets management, and MFA coordination across OpCo applications and clinical data estates in alignment with HIPAA, GDPR, China PIPL, and other applicable data protection regimes.

  • Secure the platform's OT and manufacturing plant environments across global manufacturing sites in coordination with the central OT/manufacturing security function, including plant engagement, site-level operations, and OT segmentation using IEC 62443 or NIST 800-82; run the platform cyber PMO across multiple time zones, including cadence, RAG reporting, resource loading, initiative execution, KPI/posture reporting, and application of the Danaher Business System to drive continuous improvement, standard work, and problem solving.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, with 12+ years of information security experience including direct ownership of a cybersecurity function serving multiple business units, sites, or operating companies within a global organization.

  • Demonstrated experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, Business Unit or Divisional CISO, or equivalent senior cyber leader accountable for an end-to-end program spanning security architecture, risk management, assurance, application/data security, and coordination with SOC and incident response.

  • Experience leading an information security function through multiple layers of management across globally distributed teams and time zones.

  • Experience operating in a decentralized, multi-business-unit environment, including influencing without direct authority, balancing enterprise standards with operating-company autonomy, and driving execution through matrixed relationships.

  • Experience owning cybersecurity certification and audit programs, including ISO 27001, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or equivalent, and leading customer security questionnaire and third-party assurance response at scale.

  • Experience partnering on product security for connected medical devices, IVD instruments, or other regulated hardware, including FDA premarket and postmarket medical device cybersecurity requirements, as well as running a cybersecurity program across multiple countries and data-protection regimes such as HIPAA, GDPR, China PIPL, or equivalent.

  • Experience with cyber diligence and post-close integration for mergers and acquisitions.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 25-30% of the time, including international travel to Diagnostics operating company sites.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Cybersecurity leadership within medical devices, IVD, diagnostics, life sciences, or an equivalent regulated, patient-facing industry.

  • Deep familiarity with FDA Section 524B, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62443-4-1/4-2, and EU IVDR / MDR cybersecurity expectations.

  • AI security governance, including secure use of AI-assisted development tools, LLM application security, and data governance for AI workloads that touch clinical or patient data.

The Technical Facilities and Project Manager is a key member of the Global Facilities and Real Estate team responsible for delivering and continuously improving Genesys workplaces globally. Supporting a portfolio of more than 40 locations, this role translates global workplace strategy into repeatable, sound solutions while adapting to local requirements. Reporting to the Director, Global Workplace, the position partners with regional facilities teams, business leaders, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, landlords, vendors, sustainability and security teams, and other senior stakeholders.

This role provides meaningful visibility across global workplace initiatives and the opportunity to influence how Genesys facilities evolve as the portfolio and workplace needs change. Through close partnership across regions and functions, the role helps create reliable, sustainable, and effective workplaces that support employees and the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead multiple concurrent workplace design, construction, renovation, infrastructure, and facilities improvement projects from planning and due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.

Technical Facilities Leadership

jobs.description:
Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

(FYI, we're lucky to get a lot of interest and we appreciate every application — please note we'll only reach out if you've been selected for an interview.)

About Parallels

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it's desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels delivers speed, security, and affordability for the modern work environment.

It is our policy and practice to offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
Job Post: Patient Outreach Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

Work Days: Monday – Friday

Salary: $5 - $6 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Our client is a well-established U.S.-based prosthetics and orthotics healthcare provider with approximately 30 clinic locations. We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and proactive Patient Outreach Specialist to join the remote scheduling and patient access team.

In this patient-facing role, you will help patients move efficiently from an initial inquiry, referral, or prescription to a scheduled appointment at the appropriate clinic. You will communicate with patients through phone, email, chat, and text while coordinating with physician offices and internal healthcare teams to ensure required information and documentation are complete.

This position is ideal for someone who combines excellent patient communicationwith strong organization and follow-through. You should be comfortable making outbound calls, guiding patients through next steps, handling objections or concerns professionally, and managing multiple patient cases in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Above all, you will help create a positive patient experience by making the scheduling process as clear, efficient, and supportive as possible.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Outreach & Communication

  • Handle inbound and outbound patient inquiries through phone, email, chat, and text
  • Communicate with patients professionally, empathetically, and in accordance with HIPAA requirements
  • Promptly contact patients following an inquiry, referral, or prescription
  • Gather required demographic, insurance, referral, prescription, and relevant clinical information
  • Assess patient needs using established product, service, and scheduling guidelines
  • Clearly explain scheduling requirements, next steps, and expectations
  • Address questions and concerns while helping patients understand what is needed to proceed
  • Follow up consistently with patients who have incomplete information or outstanding requirements
  • Maintain professionalism when communicating with upset, hesitant, or difficult-to-reach patients
  • Send approved patient reminders, updates, newsletters, or other communications as needed

Patient Scheduling & Access Coordination

  • Schedule patients for prosthetic and orthotic appointments at the appropriate clinic
  • Determine the appropriate scheduling location based on patient needs, location, device type, documentation status, and provider availability
  • Support patient-facing scheduling and calendar coordination
  • Ensure required information and documentation are received and reviewed before scheduling
  • Coordinate with patients, physician offices, intake, billing, clinic teams, and other support departments to resolve barriers to care
  • Escalate difficult patient concerns, incomplete documentation, unreachable patients, or workflow barriers to the appropriate supervisor or department
  • Help ensure each patient interaction ends with a clear and appropriate next step

Documentation & Follow-Up

  • Review and confirm required documentation, including prescriptions, insurance information, physician details, referrals, and other necessary records
  • Accurately enter and maintain patient information in applicable systems
  • Document all patient interactions, outreach attempts, appointment details, and follow-up actions
  • Sort, prioritize, and respond to patient emails, text messages, and other communications in a timely manner
  • Maintain organized follow-up workflows for multiple patient cases
  • Protect patient confidentiality and ensure all documentation and communication meet HIPAA standards
  • Take ownership of assigned patient interactions through the appropriate next step or escalation

Additional Support

  • Collaborate with intake, billing, clinic operations, support teams, and leadership
  • Participate in virtual training, coaching sessions, team meetings, and remote huddles
  • Assist with internal calendar coordination when needed
  • Participate in community outreach events or virtual health education sessions when requested

What Success Looks Like

A successful Patient Outreach Specialist delivers an exceptional patient experience while helping patients get scheduled quickly, accurately, and compassionately.

Success in this position includes:

  • Timely and consistent patient outreach
  • Accurate and complete documentation
  • Strong follow-up and ownership of patient cases
  • Efficient and accurate appointment scheduling
  • Clear, compassionate, and professional communication
  • Effective coordination with internal teams and physician offices
  • Proper escalation of barriers or incomplete requirements
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA and confidentiality standards
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in healthcare, patient scheduling, patient access, customer service, call center operations, sales, or another patient-facing role
  • Experience handling inbound and/or outbound calls
  • Comfortable conducting proactive patient outreach and following established scripts or workflows
  • Ability to professionally address questions, concerns, and objections while guiding patients toward an appropriate next step
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong listening skills and ability to understand patient needs, concerns, urgency, and scheduling barriers
  • Compassionate, patient, and professional communication style
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple patient cases, communications, follow-ups, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and metrics-driven environment
  • Strong follow-through and ownership of assigned patient interactions
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with intake, billing, clinic operations, physician offices, support teams, and leadership
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and commitment to protecting confidential patient information
  • Positive and resilient attitude when handling rejection, upset patients, incomplete information, or unsuccessful outreach attempts

Preferred Experience

  • 1–3 years of relevant patient-facing or healthcare experience
  • Previous experience with prosthetics and orthotics
  • Durable Medical Equipment (DME) experience
  • Medical scheduling or patient access experience
  • Referral and prescription coordination experience
  • Experience verifying or collecting insurance information
  • Experience communicating with physician offices
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems
  • Experience with VoIP or healthcare phone systems
  • Experience with chat or text-based patient communication platforms
  • Experience working with a U.S.-based healthcare organization

Basic requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English
  • Must have relevant healthcare, administrative, customer service, or patient-facing work experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required
  • Must be comfortable participating in virtual training, coaching sessions, and remote team huddles
  • Must maintain HIPAA-compliant work practices and patient confidentiality at all times
  • Must not have concurrent employment during scheduled working hours
  • Must be available for the required 40-hour workweek

Technical Requirements

  • Device: Reliable laptop or desktop computer
  • Internet: High-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps)
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset
  • Video: Webcam for virtual meetings
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Dispatchers and load planners encouraged to apply — if you've been quoting and negotiating rates on your own loads, you already do half this job

Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies. We are currently expanding and looking to add a motivated individual to our team. The Contract Pricing Analyst is responsible for developing, analyzing, and maintaining pricing structures for customer and carrier contracts. This role bridges sales, carrier sourcing, and finance by ensuring pricing accuracy, competitiveness, and profitability across long-term freight agreements, while supporting negotiation strategy with data-driven insight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain contract rate structures for customer freight agreements, including base rates, fuel surcharges, accessorials, and lane-specific pricing
  • Analyze historical freight data, market rate trends, and carrier costs to recommend competitive and profitable pricing
  • Partner with Sales and Carrier Sourcing teams to build pricing proposals for RFPs (Requests for Proposal) and bid responses
  • Model margin impact of proposed contract terms and flag deals falling outside target profitability thresholds
  • Monitor contract compliance — ensuring invoiced rates match agreed contract terms — and resolve pricing discrepancies
  • Track lane-level and account-level profitability over the life of a contract, recommending renegotiation when margins erode
  • Maintain pricing databases/tools (TMS, Excel models, or pricing software) with up-to-date rate cards
  • Conduct market benchmarking (e.g., DAT, Freightwaves SONAR) to validate pricing against spot and contract market conditions
  • Support renewal cycles by analyzing contract performance and preparing renewal/renegotiation recommendations
  • Collaborate with Legal/HR/Finance on contract terms that carry pricing implications (fuel escalators, minimum volume commitments, accessorial schedules)

Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
    • 2-3 years of experience in Dispatch, pricing, revenue management, or analytics — freight/logistics/3PL experience strongly preferred
    • Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, modeling); SQL or BI tool experience (Power BI/Tableau) an asset
    • Familiarity with TMS platforms (McLeod, Trimble, MercuryGate, etc.) and freight market data sources (DAT, SONAR)
    • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with high attention to detail
    • Ability to translate data into clear pricing recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
    • Strong communication skills to support cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Carrier Sourcing, and Finance

Benefits

  • Competitive Pay
  • Career Growth

The Sr Manager, Sales leads an enterprise software sales team responsible for growing revenue, retaining customers, and expanding adoption across a large installed customer base in North America. This role sets the team’s commercial direction, translates business trends and customer insight into territory strategy, and builds a repeatable operating rhythm for account planning, pipeline creation, forecasting, renewals, migrations, and expansion. The Sr Manager is accountable for an annual team quota and develops a high-performing team through coaching, clear performance expectations, talent development, and close partnership with Customer Success, Services, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a sales team to achieve the annual operating plan, team quota, customer retention goals, and assigned performance indicators.

  • Build and execute an install-base growth strategy that increases customer value through renewals, cross-sell, upsell, product adoption, migrations, and expansion into additional business units or subsidiaries.

  • Own territory and account planning, including segmentation, whitespace analysis, executive engagement plans, opportunity prioritization, and coordinated action plans for at-risk customers.

  • Coach direct reports through complex enterprise sales cycles, negotiations, pricing and concession decisions, executive presentations, escalations, and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Services, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Revenue Operations to remove barriers, improve the customer experience, and maximize recurring revenue.

Client & Team Collaboration

Candidate Experience

  • Deliver a professional and responsive recruitment experience.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.
  • Experience in agency, staffing, or offshore recruitment.
  • Experience recruiting for Sales, Executive Assistant, Customer Support, Marketing, Operations, and Technical roles.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation abilities.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, job boards, and sourcing tools.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting international remote talent.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based clients.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, Slack, or recruiting CRM platforms.
  • Background in staffing, BPO, or offshore recruitment.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality candidate shortlists delivered quickly.
  • Strong interview-to-hire conversion rates.
  • Organized ATS and recruitment pipelines.
  • Excellent candidate experience and engagement.
  • High hiring manager and client satisfaction.

Interview Process

  • Application Review
  • Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  • Internal Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please check both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Join us on the

Product Management team as a Product Manager –Mobile Platform, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.

Start your journey with Anova today!

Role Summary

This role's center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You'll grow into deeper ownership as you build your track record here.

The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery across a defined product area within the Anova Unify platform. Working closely with a Senior PM or Director, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands-on execution role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won't be handed a roadmap to execute — you'll help shape it.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. Build conviction before building product.
  • Own your backlog end-to-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. Prioritize ruthlessly. Keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity.
  • Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release. Monitor adoption post-launch. Share what you're learning with the broader team and make fast, evidence-based adjustments.
  • Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner. Unblock your team. Make trade-off calls with good judgment and know when to escalate.
  • Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
  • Enable go-to-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you've shipped and why it matters.
  • Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area. Maintain a feedback loop with support and customer success to surface patterns early.

Outcomes you'll own

  • Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers.
  • Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves.
  • Discovery pipeline. A healthy, evidence-backed backlog — prioritized from real customer insight, validated with data, and ready for engineering.
  • On-time, high-quality delivery. Your area ships on cadence and predictably. Specs are clear, edge cases are handled, and engineering isn't blocked waiting for answers.
  • Squad metrics. You track velocity, cycle time, and escaped defects — not to report up, but to spot friction early and remove it.
  • NPS contribution. Customers in your product area trust the product and feel heard. You stay close to feedback, close the loop on issues, and bring the voice of the customer into every decision.

How you'll work at Anova

  • Specs, one-pagers, and decision memos are how we align a global, distributed team — writing clearly forces clear thinking. AI can help you draft, but writing well remains your skill to own.
  • You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products.
  • You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes.
  • 6+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions.
  • You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used.
  • Track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software in close partnership with engineering teams — from spec to production — using Agile/DevOps.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well-scoped backlog items.
  • Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
  • Ability to write clear, structured specs, one-pagers, and narratives for cross-functional audiences.
  • Comfort reasoning about technical trade-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers.
  • Data fluency: define metrics, pull and analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence-based roadmap calls.

Preferred Qualifications -
