jobs.title: Cloud Platform and Security Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Remote role Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.
jobs.description:
Remote role

Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.

This is an assessment engagement, not an implementation. You will not build, configure, integrate, remediate, or operate anything. You will examine what has already been built, review the evidence, interview the people who built it, and reach independent, defensible conclusions for executive leadership. Independence from the program's implementation vendors is a contractual requirement of the engagement.

The scope covers nine assessment domains and 65 discrete assessment requirements: program governance and risk, business process alignment, architecture and design, integration and data management, mainframe and legacy modernization, security and privacy compliance, software development lifecycle and configuration management, testing and quality assurance, and operational readiness. The technology environment includes a major cloud customer relationship management platform, a public cloud infrastructure estate, an enterprise integration platform, a content management platform, intelligent document processing, and a mainframe lift-and-refactor migration.

Deliverables include an assessment management plan, an initial assessment report, recurring status briefings, per-domain assessment reports, readiness assessments, an executive briefing, and a final assessment report.
You will work full time for four months in a small paired-team structure alongside senior peers. Findings go directly to executive leadership and to a legislative oversight body.

Required

  • 10 or more years in cloud architecture with deep Amazon Web Services (AWS) experience — network design, identity and access management, security groups, monitoring, resilience, disaster recovery, and governance controls
  • Security architecture assessment — identity and access management, encryption, logging, monitoring, and tracing security requirements through to their implementation in configuration
  • CJIS compliance experience — high priority. CJIS stands for Criminal Justice Information Services, the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation security policy that governs handling of criminal justice data. The client holds law enforcement data and employs sworn investigators, so this is a real requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Privacy controls, records retention, and audit logging assessment
  • Vendor risk management and software supply chain security — including SBOM
About Us: Sabot Consulting is a management consulting company focused on providing technical and management consulting to IT executives and managers in strategic, operational, and project-based practice areas. Our focus on providing expert staff that have the knowledge, experience, and professionalism to engage the client at all levels is the key to our success.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical BI Analyst (Ambulatory Analytics)
jobs.excerpt: At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community.
jobs.description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

As an integral member of the Analytics Team, the Senior Technical Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst is responsible for providing advanced technical expertise in one or more analytics toolsets to support the creation of information-based, business intelligence deliverables that will be relied upon by organizational leaders to support critical business decisions. The Senior Technical BI Analyst will work with customers from clinical, administrative and/or operational areas across the System to provide advanced analytical tools that drive insights, complex data extracts and data integration, reports and/or advanced dashboard visualizations to facilitate discovery of insights, new opportunities, support data-informed decision-making for identified challenges as well as develop new and enhance existing metrics to analyze ongoing performance metrics. This position may be tasked to become competent in specific business areas or functional units to support transformation of data and information into actionable insights that answer complex business questions. The Senior Technical BI Analyst will work with customers to understand and define the problems being solved, facilitate procurement and integration of the disparate data sources necessary to analyze the needs appropriately, deliver relevant analytics tools to meet customer’s objectives and implement and support the solutions for ongoing utilization. This role will also troubleshoot complex technical problems and serve in a senior technical advisory role to other BI, Specialized BI and Technical BI Analysts as well as others across the System’s Analytics Community. The Senior Technical BI Analyst may also be responsible for analyzing and integrating disparate data sources to ETL into an EDW either through a direct integration or through a normalization process.

Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, management information systems, data science, business administration, statistics, or related field or equivalent experience required. Master’s degree highly preferred.

Licenses/Certifications: Technical certifications in relevant application(s) strongly preferred (i.e., Tableau). Associate Certified Analytics Professional (aCAP) or another vendor-neutral analytics certification preferred.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency with one or more of the following tools required, credentials/certification preferred, as specified for position’s needs:

    • Database and Query Languages – CCL, SQL, Nomad, Oracle, Vertica, Snowflake

    • Visualization tools – Tableau (preferred), Spotfire, Sisense, Qlik or Microsoft PowerBI

    • Data Visualization Server Administration tools – Tableau Core and Data Management Server

    • Data Prep/Transformation tools – Tableau Prep, Hadoop, Alteryx, Paxata, Trifacta, Altair, Talend

    • Statistical tools – R, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, Minitab

    • Data Science tools – R, Python, SAS, dataiku, DataRobot, Cnvrg, Anaconda

  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite: Excel (Pivot tables, VBA, Macros), Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Access, required

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience collaborating with customers on the design, creation and execution of analytics deliverables.

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience in building complex self-service analytic reports, dashboards and/or tools supporting decision-making and actionable metric monitoring by customers.

  • Demonstrated experience working in a dynamic, matrixed organization with executive exposure.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking and advanced creative problem-solving skills with aptitude to exert influence without authority through interpreting requirements and guiding customers to the desired analytics outcomes.

  • Analytic mindset able to draw conclusions from raw data and summarize results efficiently using logic and reasoning to identify approaches to problems.

  • Ability to visualize data in a meaningful way to communicate effectively the meaning and the necessary action to be taken.

  • Act with an intellectual curiosity to obtain insights from data and search for solutions to the problems being explored as well as new ones to be discovered.

  • Understand math and statistical concepts to provide analysis to formulate meaningful decisions.

  • Exceptional time management skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, specifically with an ability to communicate effectively across multiple management levels.

  • Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team under established deadlines to drive critical outcomes.

  • Create a positive work environment that fosters successful team performance.

  • Strong customer service, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Advise, support and train fellow members of the Analytics Team as well as individual analytics efforts across the System through expertise with technical business intelligence tools, concepts, processes and techniques.

  • Serves as advanced-level, technical advisor to others offering high level support, mentorship, education and training.

  • Ongoing interactions with subject matter domain experts within the organization to enhance knowledge of business, clinical and administrative processes and applications utilized by the various clients.

  • Partner with respective customers to design, develop and implement high level analytics tools that drive actionable insights in support of operational, strategic and tactical metrics for optimization.

  • Partner with the greater Analytics team to evolve Memorial Hermann’s Analytics Maturity Level to incorporate the full analytics spectrum of descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive analytics.

  • Collaborate with the greater Analytics Team to develop the data architecture strategy, implementation plan and customer-delivered toolset.

  • Active participation in and support of the Memorial Hermann Data Governance Program.

  • Perform regular and ad-hoc user-friendly reports and visualizations for executive and client review.

  • Continuous improvement of analytics services and operations through processes to detect and resolve data anomalies in a proactive/timely manner as well as keeping knowledgeable of and championing the implementation of emerging technologies and techniques to better analyze, distribute and integrate information.

  • Provide support from data model, quality, integrity, validity analysis through resolution to correct deficiencies within analytic, reporting and visualization applications.

  • Continually further analytics knowledge and skill set through various channels to ensure MHHS remains on the cutting edge of the Healthcare industry.

  • Key member of the project team supporting curriculum development and responsible for training new analytic professionals to meet the established standard.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.

A dedicated Insurance Virtual Assistant (assigned to a single agency/client) who owns day-to-day agency operations: quoting and new-business intake, policy servicing and endorsements, client-facing phone/email reception, renewals and remarketing, submissions and document/signature workflows, AMS/data entry and file management, billing/payments and client onboarding, plus technical/support, marketing/CRM and other client-assigned administrative tasks. All items below come only from the Active VA — Top 5 Activities form responses.

Core responsibilities (detailed tasks)

Quoting & new business

  • Intake quote information and complete ACORDs / quote sheets.
  • Run comparative/rater quotes in carrier portals and tools (examples in the responses) and prepare/send quote proposals to clients/brokers.
  • Quote specialized/ancillary lines when required (examples: crime, D&O, umbrella, WC, commercial trucking).

Policy servicing & administration

  • Process endorsements and policy changes (add/remove vehicles or drivers, address and coverage changes).
  • Handle mortgagee / loss-payee updates and prepare endorsements.
  • Process cancellations and non-renewals (verify requests, prepare necessary paperwork, notify clients).
  • Generate ID cards, declarations pages and proofs of insurance; manage Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and commercial certificate workflows.

Customer service — phone & email

  • Field inbound calls and act as receptionist via VOIP/phone systems; triage voicemail and manage call queues.
  • Respond to policyholder inquiries by email/chat and perform client follow-ups.
  • Handle billing and payment questions and place reminder calls as needed.

Renewals & retention

  • Track renewal pipeline per client SOPs, send renewal notifications/reminders, schedule policy-review appointments, remarket and follow up proactively to bind renewals. (Several responses describe following a renewal SOP and proactive remarketing.)

Submissions, document preparation & signature workflows

  • Prepare and submit new-business and renewal packages to markets/carriers; assemble application packages and required supporting documents.
  • Create and manage e-signature workflows (DocuSign, PandaDoc and similar) and send bind applications to brokers/carriers; handle invoicing/collection related to bindings.

AMS / data entry & file management

  • Accurate data entry and maintenance of client and policy records in agency systems; upload/download/attach media and carrier documents.
  • Onboard clients into the AMS: create/update client profiles, notes and onboarding documentation.
  • Handle returned mail and address updates; keep AMS renewal and activity records current.

Billing, payments & financing

  • Take payments and process invoicing; follow up on collections and payment reminders.
  • Process financing plans or payment arrangements when required.

Technical & operational support

  • Triage and resolve support tickets and sales/support inbox items, handle telephony/short-code mail verifications (TFNS) and service requests noted in responses.
  • Manage voicemail/AI-voicemail triage (examples include CARA AI voicemail).

Marketing, CRM & administrative support

  • CRM data entry and lead tracking, manage email campaigns and basic marketing tasks (social media and website management, campaign creation).
  • Draft proposals and client communications tied to sales/marketing workflows.

Other specialist tasks reported

  • Look up property features and permits (county appraiser, Zillow, Google Maps) for underwriting or quoting.
  • Process carrier-specific portal tasks and appointed portal actions.
  • Handle onboarding notes, client file preparation and ad-hoc client requests.

Common systems & tools (examples taken from the form responses)

  • Quoting / portals: EZLynx, CoverWhale, QQ Rater, carrier portals.
  • AMS / CRMs: NowCerts (Momentum), AMS360, Hawksoft, QQCatalyst, Keeper, Jenesis, Zoho.
  • Communications / phone: RingCentral, Dialpad, Fonality, Vonage, 8x8, Zoom Phone.
  • Signatures & documents: DocuSign, PandaDoc; productivity: Gmail/Outlook, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Google Sheets, Trello, GoHighLevel.
  • Other tools mentioned: IPFS.com, ChatGPT.

This is a strong opportunity for a leader who wants to make an impact beyond the daily workflow. You will balance customer needs, claim quality, service levels, employee development, and frequent technology and process enhancements. You will also have the support and visibility to contribute ideas, develop future leaders, and help build a best-in-class claims experience.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Experience developing high-potential employees and supporting succession or career-development planning.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale.

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Germany
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Germany.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

jobs.description:

With a deep passion for serving those who shape our future, we make event operations effortless – so schools can focus on what truly matters: creating lasting impact in their hometowns.

Job Description:

Location:Remote

Type: Full-time, independent contractor (long-term engagement)

Hours: Full-time, with a minimum of 5 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (9:00am–5:00pm ET core business hours)

Who We Are:
Hometown is the trusted leader in the education space, equipping athletic directors, coaches, and school administrators with the tools they need to manage their department communications, live events, and fundraisers. Hometown offers an all-in-one, easy-to-use platform to support schools in creating memorable in-person experiences and lasting impact in their communities. We’re continuing to expand our technology and team to provide the best-in-class service to organizations across the country!

Hometown empowers all team members through a positive company culture. Exemplifying our core values of Hustle, Excellence, Resilience, and Ownership (HERO). We’re committed to providing a safe and inclusive work experience for everyone, both those working remotely and within our offices across the country. Consider joining our team today!

Role Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Solutions Architect to own our Salesforce instance end to end. You will be the technical owner of the platform that runs our go-to-market motion. You will be a part of our Business Operations team and report directly to our Senior Director of Operations.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not an advisory one. You will inherit a mature, actively used org with automations, integrations, and reporting dependencies, and you will be responsible for keeping it healthy, making it better, and expanding it to support our multi-product go-to-market strategy across ticketing, fundraising, and websites and mobile apps.

The person who succeeds here is someone who has done this at more than one company, can reverse-engineer an unfamiliar org, can receive business requirements directly from Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, and can then design, build, test, and ship the change themselves. We are hiring for judgment and ownership as much as for build skill. You will be the person the business asks “can Salesforce do this?” and the person who decides the answer and implements it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ownership of the Salesforce instance: declarative configuration, permission sets and profiles, page layouts, record types, sharing rules, sandbox strategy, and release management.

  • Maintain and stabilize: inherit the existing automation footprint (Flows, validation rules, assignment logic, approval processes), document what exists, retire what’s redundant, and eliminate the technical debt that accumulates in any fast-moving org.

  • Improve and expand: identify friction in how our reps and CS team actually work, propose the fix, and ship it. Reduce clicks, improve data quality, and make the system reflect how the business actually sells.

  • Build out our multi-product GTM in Salesforce: design the data model, opportunity architecture, product catalog, and pipeline structure required to sell, renew, and report on multiple products to the same school and district accounts. This includes cross-sell and upsell motion, product-level revenue reporting, bundling, and renewal architecture.

  • Own the integrated stack: maintain and improve how Salesforce connects to Snowflake (our data warehouse), Gong (conversation intelligence and deal insight), and our other go-to-market and billing systems. Partner on data flows in both directions and ensure Salesforce remains the trusted source of truth for GTM data.

  • Reporting and dashboards: build and maintain the reports, dashboards, and forecasting views that leadership, sales management, and Customer Success run on. Be opinionated about what “good” looks like.

  • Gather requirements autonomously: run your own discovery with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and leadership. Translate business problems into system design without requiring a project manager or business analyst in between.

  • Governance and enablement: own user management and onboarding, data hygiene standards, field and object documentation, change control, and training for end users on what you build.

  • Vendor and AppExchange management: evaluate, implement, and rationalize the third-party tools connected to the org.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • 4–8 years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including primary ownership of at least one production org.

  • Experience across multiple companies’ Salesforce instances. You’ve walked into orgs you didn’t build, figured out how they work, and improved them. We need someone who has done the inheriting before.

  • Deep declarative expertise: Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled), validation rules, formula fields, dynamic forms, approval processes, permission set and sharing architecture, and complex data modeling.

  • Comfortable reading, debugging, and reasoning about code. You can open Apex, triggers, and Lightning Web Components, understand what they do, identify when they’re the cause of a problem, and work with a developer or vendor to fix them.

  • Reporting and data fluency: advanced Salesforce reporting, data loading and migration

  • Integration experience. You’ve owned or heavily supported Salesforce integrations with a data warehouse, conversation intelligence tooling, marketing automation, or billing systems.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification required; Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Sales Cloud Consultant strongly preferred.

  • Professional English fluency, written and verbal. You’ll be running requirements conversations directly with US-based stakeholders, including leadership.

  • Demonstrated autonomy: a track record of operating as the only Salesforce person in the room, setting your own priorities against business goals, and driving change without being managed task to task.

Nice To Have:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS selling to schools, districts, higher education, or the public sector.

  • Sandbox and deployment discipline: change sets, SFDX, Gearset, Copado, or similar.

  • Experience with Salesforce AI features (Agentforce, Einstein) or Salesforce-connected AI tooling.

  • Experience supporting a company through a product expansion, acquisition integration, or org consolidation.

  • Experience architecting multi-product or multi-line-of-business selling in Salesforce (product catalog, CPQ or CPQ-adjacent quoting, bundling, product-level revenue reporting).

Compensation:
Fixed monthly amount of $5,000 USD

Our compensation ranges are determined by a variety of factors, including role responsibilities, market data, and an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications. The final offer will be based on these factors and discussed throughout the interview process.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain stationary for a long period of time, including working on a computer.

  • This position may also be required to travel to client sites or conferences. This could include standing and walking for prolonged periods of time, and while outdoors in various weather conditions.

  • Hometown values the importance of demonstrating to our customers that we care and are invested in our product and how it can be the best solution for them. All Hometown employees have a minimum amount of client events they must attend per year. This may include traveling to local client sites and could include standing and walking for prolonged periods of time, and while outdoors in various weather conditions.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Operations Coordinator to keep day-to-day business operations organized, measurable, and moving efficiently across multiple departments.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows, tracking performance, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring teams consistently follow through on operational priorities.

You’ll coordinate across functions including Operations, Finance, HR, Customer Service, Logistics, IT, and Vendor Management, serving as a key connection point between teams while giving leadership clear visibility into KPIs, deadlines, risks, bottlenecks, and operational performance.

Process & Workflow Coordination

Documentation & SOP Management

THE OPPORTUNITY: A new opportunity for an enthusiastic and highly driven electrical or mechanical estimator who enjoys dealing with people and wants to move into the tech industry.

Countfire is cloud-based takeoff and estimating software for electrical, mechanical and other construction contractors. We're growing in the United States and Canada, so this role supports customers on both sides of the Atlantic. Your working hours will include cover for North American business hours, which we'll agree with you up front.

You've probably not done a job like this before, and that's fine. Your estimating knowledge is the essential ingredient. The rest we'll teach you, with comprehensive on-the-job training in a supportive and collaborative environment. You'll be given clear processes to follow and won't be expected to figure things out on your own.

ABOUT VALSOFT CORPORATION:

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft has grown to a global portfolio of 120+ companies, acquiring and developing vertical market software companies, enabling each business to deliver the best mission-critical solutions for customers in their respective industries. A key tenet of Valsoft’s philosophy is to invest in well-established businesses and foster an entrepreneurial environment that moulds companies into leaders in their respective industries. Valsoft looks to buy, hold, and create value through long-term partnerships with existing management.

ABOUT COUNTFIRE:

Countfire is revolutionizing the construction industry with our automated takeoff software that's transforming how electrical contractors, estimators, and construction professional’s work. We're a fast-growing SaaS scale-up backed by ambitious goals and a team that's passionate about solving real-world problems with innovative technology.

Our team is lean, agile, and results driven. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, experiment, and grow alongside our business. When you join Countfire, you're not just taking a job, you're joining a mission to make estimators superhuman and digitally transform an entire industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Answer inbound support enquiries from users in the UK, US and Canada, professionally and quickly.
  • Run training sessions with new customers as part of their onboarding, following our training format.
  • Learn the product inside out so users get the full benefit of every feature.
  • Use your first-hand estimating experience to relate to what users are trying to achieve.
  • Explain technical features in a simple way that people can understand.
  • Follow our internal processes accurately so every type of request is handled the right way.
  • Help maintain our response time (we aim to respond to any support request within 2 minutes).
  • Keep accurate records of the support conversations you handle.
    •

What we Provide

  • Comprehensive product and support training.
  • Coaching from experienced product specialists.
  • Clear, documented processes for every type of support request.
  • Set formats and materials for customer training sessions.
  • The tools you need to do the job well.
  • A collaborative remote team that shares knowledge openly.
    •

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years experience as an Electrical or Mechanical Estimator, or in a customer support or technical role within the electrical, mechanical, or construction industry.
  • A strong interest in technology and a desire to build a career in software.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and approachable way.
  • A customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for helping people succeed.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow established processes consistently.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer enquiries.
  • Confidence delivering customer training, presentations, or demonstrations (or the willingness to learn).
  • The ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while collaborating effectively with a global team.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to achieving individual and team performance goals.
  • Flexibility to work scheduled hours that overlap with customers in the United States and Canada.

Need to Have

  • Reliable computer with stable high-speed internet.

· Professional headset.

  • Quiet, private workspace suitable for handling customer information.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using estimating or takeoff software such as Countfire, Trimble, Bluebeam, Accubid, ConEst, McCormick, or similar platforms.
  • Previous experience in a customer support, technical support, help desk, onboarding, or software training role.
  • Experience working with CRM or customer support platforms (such as HubSpot, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar).
  • Experience delivering virtual customer training sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) products and cloud-based applications.
    •

* This is a remote role supporting customers in the UK and North America. Your schedule will include agreed cover for North American business hours, alongside team meetings and training sessions.

Benefits

Although Countfire is an established product, we have the hunger and attitude of a young company- the best of both worlds and perfect if you're looking for somewhere you can make a real impact. The team comes from a mix of backgrounds. From ex-estimators with a wealth of industry knowledge, to developers and marketers with no estimating experience. But everyone has a lot to offer and are full of ideas and enthusiasm.

We work hard to "work smarter" using new technology tools to increase efficiency across the company, but we appreciate that not everything is in place or is perfect, so our team needs to be prepared (and excited!) for change.

#Countfire

We are seeking a Workday Technical Consultant with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development. The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform. The ideal candidate combines strong Workday platform knowledge with practical engineering discipline and the ability to translate business requirements into clean, maintainable Workday configurations. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Design and develop complex calculated fields, custom reports, and advanced reports using the Workday report writer.

  • Configure and maintain business processes, condition rules, and approval routing across HCM and Finance.
  • Develop Workday Extend applications and PRISM analytics where appropriate, packaging custom logic in supported platform extensions rather than fragile customizations that complicate future upgrades.
  • Build report-as-a-service integrations and support data export needs for downstream systems.
  • Configure security domains, role-based security, and segment-based security across complex tenants.
  • Partner with HR, payroll, and finance stakeholders to translate requirements into Workday configurations.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for business processes, calculated fields, and security models.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, regression testing cycles, and platform release adoption, validating configuration and reports against expected behavior before each move into production.
  • Troubleshoot configuration and report issues in production tenants, working closely with functional teams to isolate root causes, propose remediation, and prevent recurrence through configuration improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with integration developers on report-driven data flows, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Provide guidance on Workday best practices and configuration design patterns.
  • Participate in Workday community forums, brainstorms, and product feedback channels, contributing field perspective and bringing back valuable insights and emerging best practices to the broader team.
  • Stay current with Workday releases and platform innovations, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of Workday technical experience.
  • Deep expertise in Workday report writer including advanced and composite reports.
  • Strong proficiency with calculated fields across HCM and Finance.
  • Hands-on experience configuring business processes and condition rules.
  • Strong understanding of Workday security framework.
  • Experience with PRISM Analytics or Workday Extend.
  • Familiarity with Workday tenant management and release process.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro certifications.
  • Experience with Workday Extend application development.
  • Familiarity with PRISM data ingestion and modeling.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience supporting Workday Payroll or Workday Financials.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Risk Assessor - Water Treatment Division

Position Overview

A Risk Assessor in JLL's water treatment division evaluates and manages risks associated with water systems in commercial and industrial facilities. This role combines technical knowledge of water treatment systems with risk management expertise to protect building occupants, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain operational continuity.

Key Responsibilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis

Conduct comprehensive risk assessments of water systems including cooling towers, domestic water systems, irrigation systems, and decorative water features. Identify potential hazards such as Legionella bacteria, chemical contamination, equipment failures, and regulatory non-compliance. Evaluate the likelihood and potential impact of identified risks on building occupants, operations, and the organization.

Regulatory Compliance

Ensure water treatment programs comply with local, state, and federal regulations including EPA standards, OSHA requirements, and industry-specific guidelines. Stay current with evolving water quality regulations and industry best practices. Prepare documentation and reports for regulatory audits and inspections.

Water Quality Monitoring

Review water quality testing results and treatment program data. Identify trends or anomalies that may indicate developing risks. Recommend corrective actions when parameters fall outside acceptable ranges.

Risk Mitigation Planning

Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies and control measures. Create water safety plans and emergency response procedures. Recommend equipment upgrades, treatment modifications, or operational changes to reduce identified risks.

Client Communication and Reporting

Prepare detailed risk assessment reports for clients and stakeholders. Present findings and recommendations to facility management teams. Provide training and guidance on water safety management practices.

Collaboration

Work closely with water treatment technicians, facility engineers, environmental health and safety teams, and client representatives. Coordinate with external laboratories, consultants, and regulatory agencies as needed.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 2-5 years of experience in water treatment, facility management, environmental health and safety, or related field. Experience conducting risk assessments or audits preferred.

Technical Knowledge: Understanding of water chemistry, microbiology (particularly Legionella control), water treatment technologies, and HVAC systems. Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies and regulatory frameworks.

Certifications: Relevant certifications such as Certified Water Technologist (CWT), Certified Legionella Professional (CLP), or similar credentials are highly desirable.

Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Remote –Greater Manchester, GBR

jobs.excerpt: CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance.
jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester, Gartner and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures. We empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

Join a talented, product focussed engineering team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems within sales performance management.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in the earliest stages of product development — where the problems are ambiguous, the path is undefined, and the focus is on discovering what should exist, not just building what’s already been decided.

This is a highly creative, high-impact engineering role: you’ll help take brand-new concepts from idea → prototype → production, working closely with design, product, and customers. If you love building new experiences, validating assumptions quickly, shaping product direction, and turning abstract ideas into real software, you’ll excel here.

Remote: United States or Canada

What you’ll do:

  • Build 0→1 products: Create new services, features, and user experiences from scratch — often starting with rough prototypes and evolving them into scalable, production-ready systems.

  • Work through ambiguity: Take loosely defined, abstract problem spaces and transform them into clear technical and architectural approaches.

  • Partner deeply with product & design: Participate in customer discovery, sketch solutions, propose alternatives, challenge assumptions, and help define what valuable and delightful looks like.

  • Experiment rapidly: Build POCs, run technical spikes, validate ideas quickly, and iterate based on real customer feedback.

  • Influence product direction: Bring an engineering-driven perspective to what we build, how we build it, and what tradeoffs are worth making at early stages.

  • Design and build scalable systems once we validate the direction, balancing speed with long-term maintainability.

  • Raise the technical bar: Contribute to architectural discussions, coding standards, best practices, and mentoring other engineers.

  • Own quality end-to-end: From early prototypes to robust production code, you care deeply about reliability, performance, and customer experience.

What you’ll bring:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience shipping real products in fast-moving environments.

  • Proven success building new products or highly exploratory features (0→1, startups, innovation labs, greenfield initiatives).

  • Comfort working with high ambiguity and incomplete information — you can define direction, propose solutions, and move work forward without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Strong customer empathy and interest in learning directly from users.

  • Fluency in full-stack development (or strong backend experience paired with solid product instincts), with hands-on experience in Python/Django, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and PostgreSQL.

  • Solid understanding of system design, APIs, performance, and scalable architecture.

  • Ability to balance speed vs. quality — you know when to build scrappy and when to build durable.

  • Excellent communication skills and willingness to collaborate across disciplines.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll help define a brand-new product experience and shape its technical foundation.

  • You’ll work in a space where engineering has a huge voice in product direction.

  • You’ll operate at the intersection of creativity, customer needs, and deep technical work.

  • The problems are meaningful, the ambiguity is real, and your impact will be visible from day one.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.
  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.
  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.
  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.
  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.
  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.
  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.

Notice to Prospective Candidates:

  • Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.
  • We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.
  • Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.
  • Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.
  • Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.
  • Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.
  • Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours support, ensuring timely resolution of critical issues and maintaining system uptime.

jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: We're seeking an experienced Stock Plan Administrator to own Devoted's equity plan operations.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

We're seeking an experienced Stock Plan Administrator to own Devoted's equity plan operations. This role will develop, build, and run a best-in-class company equity plan function for the long term — one that's accurate, compliant, and easy for all shareholders (and especially employees) to navigate as we grow. You'll administer our stock option program day to day, ensure we have tools and processes to scale, inform our employee equity compensation strategy, provide education, and support shareholder liquidity as our equity program evolves.

You'll partner closely with teams across People, Legal, Accounting, Tax, Payroll, and other Finance operations, and serve as the definitive owner of the equity plan function — building the processes, controls, and documentation that scale with our investor cap table, potential transaction activity, and headcount while supporting and informing the full range of equity plan compensation activity across a growing private company. This role will report to the VP of Corporate Finance.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Oversee daily equity plan operations in Carta, including grant processing, option exercises, cancellations, repurchases, and cap table management.

  • Evaluate equity administration tools and lead implementation of new solutions.

  • Manage monthly and quarterly equity reconciliations and reporting.

  • Administer employee equity plan transactions accurately and compliantly, including any liquidity events the Company may offer, from planning through employee communications and settlement.

  • Build and optimize processes for equity plan transactions, particularly option exercises, while ensuring accuracy and compliance.

  • Support the development of equity plan tax policies and procedures in partnership with Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Payroll.

  • Design and document standard operating procedures and strong internal controls for all equity plan operations, including audit support.

  • Manage the 409A valuation process and cadence in collaboration with Legal and Accounting, and its downstream effects on grants, exercises, and liquidity events.

  • Lead HRIS and payroll system integrations to streamline equity plan operations and eliminate manual reconciliation.

  • Develop automated processes for tax withholding calculations and payroll integration, including withholding on liquidity events.

  • Create scalable workflows that support our growing headcount over a multi-year private horizon.

  • Coordinate equity plan tax calculations and timely, accurate withholding and reporting with Payroll (including Forms 3921/3922 and W-2 treatment).

  • Support the introduction of new instruments such as RSUs (including appropriate vesting design for a private company) as the program evolves.

  • Provide high-touch guidance and support to managers and employees on equity-related questions — helping them understand their equity, from grants and vesting to exercises, secondaries, taxes, and payroll impacts.

  • Manage the equity-related information verification from non-employee shareholders including, but not limited to, audit requests, shareholding confirmations, and 409a value verification.

Required skills and experience:

  • 8+ years in equity plan administration, stock plan management, or a related field.

  • Hands-on administrator-level experience with Carta; experience with Shareworks and other platforms is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of equity compensation principles and their tax treatment, including stock options (ISOs and NSOs) and RSUs, and the accounting treatment and execution experience of various private company liquidity events.

  • Proficiency with payroll systems integration and tax withholding processes.

  • A detail-oriented approach with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to both consult subject matter experts on bespoke equity issues across legal, tax, accounting, and payroll and explain complex equity concepts to employees in plain language.

Desired skills and experience:

  • A Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation.

  • Experience at a high-growth private company with a wide shareholder base.

  • Hands-on experience administering private company liquidity events.

  • Experience evaluating different forms of employee equity, introducing a new instrument, and managing it on an ongoing basis post-introduction (e.g., evaluating and introducing RSUs to an options-focused employee equity program).

  • Knowledge of US and international equity compensation and tax requirements.

  • Familiarity with ASC 718 stock-based compensation and internal controls.

  • Excellent project management skills with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with modeling.

Salary Range: $110,000 - $194,000 annually base plus annual cash bonus

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Jako Partnerships Manager budeš nejen budovat a pěstovat vztahy s existujícími partnery, ale i aktivně vyhledávat nové příležitosti. Hledáme „architekta“ partnerství, který v sobě spojuje obchodní dravost s precizním projektovým managementem a analytickým myšlením.

  • Reporting a Insights: Poskytování pravidelných reportů o výkonnosti partnerství, analýza tržních trendů a zpětná vazba pro produktový tým.

  • Administrativní exekutiva: Odpovědnost za čistý a precizní administrativní chod, projektové řízení a management všech zainteresovaných stakeholderů.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Obchodní praxe a zkušenosti: Zkušenosti s B2B obchodem, budováním partnerství nebo business developmentem (fintech zkušenost je velkým plusem).

  • Analytický mindset: Jsi doma v Excelu. Dokážeš interpretovat data, na jejich základě optimalizovat výkonnost a dělat kvalifikovaná rozhodnutí.

  • Projektové řízení: Schopnost řídit komplexní projekty, vést více stakeholderů najednou a dotahovat věci do konce.

  • Drive: Jsi iniciativní, samostatný/á a umíš být „pushy“, když je potřeba projekt posunout vpřed.

  • Komunikační dovednosti: Profesionální vystupování, schopnost vyjednávat a budovat důvěru u různých stakeholderů.

  • Jazyky: Plynulá čeština/slovenština a angličtina

Co za to?💰

  • Péče o duševní zdraví s Hedepy – abychom ti pomohli udržet si psychickou pohodu a balanc

  • Měsíční týmové meetingy v Praze – den plný inspirace, sdílení zkušeností, skvělé atmosféry i příběhů našich zákazníků

Chceš do toho jít?

Celý proces se snažíme držet svižný a přátelský – stejně jako naše kultura. Žádná zbytečná kola navíc, ale férový a otevřený přístup.

Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. About engineering at Wave

We care about the big picture. We don’t hire engineers to just ship tickets. We hire them to solve problems. That means caring deeply about outcomes, understanding context, and jumping in wherever something’s broken, even if it’s technically “not your area.” When we see problems, inefficiencies, or opportunities to make something better, we act. We dig into operational issues, clarify fuzzy product specs, or step into unfamiliar code to help unblock teammates.

We move as fast as possible. Speed matters. It lets us try things quickly, get feedback early, and course-correct while it’s cheap. So we write small PRs. We aim for MVPs. We leave TODOs and file follow-ups. We don’t over-perfect v1. That said, we’re building a financial product. Some things—like money movement, correctness, or security—deserve more caution.

We like boring technology. We favor tools that are reliable, well-understood, and easy to debug. This keeps us focused on solving meaningful problems instead of wrestling with unpredictable infrastructure. If a new technology helps us move faster, build safer, or solve a real need, we’ll consider it. But we don’t adopt tools just because they’re new—we adopt them because they’re right.

Simplicity is a strategy. It lets us focus our energy where it matters most: serving our users.

Tutors do not complete assignments for students, provide answers to graded work, predict examination content, independently modify course requirements, or serve as the instructor of record.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid
